title: DeepSlide: From Artifacts to Presentation Delivery
summary: DeepSlide 是一个面向完整演示流程的人机协同多智能体系统，覆盖从需求获取、时间预算叙事规划到基于证据的幻灯片-脚本生成、注意力增强及排练等环节。与传统AI幻灯片生成器仅优化视觉产物不同，它首次系统性优化交付过程（节奏、叙事与准备）。该系统在叙事连贯性与时间控制上显著优于基线，为Agent驱动的多模态内容生成与交付优化提供了新范式。
raw_content: Presentations are a primary medium for scholarly communication, yet most AI slide generators optimize the artifact (a visually plausible deck) while under-optimizing the delivery process (pacing, narrative, and presentation preparation). We present DeepSlide, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent system that supports preparing the full presentation process, from requirement elicitation and time-budgeted narrative planning, to evidence-grounded slide--script generation, attention augmentation, and rehe

title: SDOF: Taming the Alignment Tax in Multi-Agent Orchestration with State-Constrained Dispatch
summary: SDOF 是一个多智能体编排框架，将执行过程建模为受约束的状态机，以解决现有框架（如LangChain、LangGraph）缺乏业务阶段约束的问题。通过在线RLHF专用意图路由器和状态感知调度器两个防御层，SDOF在保持任务完成质量的同时，将编排中的对齐代价（Alignment Tax）降低了37%。该工作为多智能体系统在复杂业务流程中的可靠执行提供了关键的状态约束机制，对Agent编排的实用化部署具有重要价值。
raw_content: Multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and CrewAI route tasks through graph-based pipelines but do not enforce the stage constraints that govern real business processes. We present SDOF, a framework that treats multi-agent execution as a constrained state machine. title: AgentStop: Terminating Local AI Agents Early to Save Energy in Consumer Devices
summary: AgentStop 提出一种面向消费设备的本地 AI 智能体早期终止机制，旨在解决 LLM 驱动的自主智能体在设备端执行多步骤任务时的高能耗问题。关键亮点是能在保证任务完成质量的前提下，平均节省 30% 以上的能源消耗。该工作与 Agent 方向紧密相关，为资源受限设备上的本地智能体部署提供了实用的能效优化方案。
raw_content: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate complex, multi-step tasks such as coding or web-based question answering. While remote, cloud-based agents offer scalability and ease of deployment, they raise privacy concerns, depend on network connectivity, and incur recurring API costs. Deploying agents locally on user devices mitigates these issues by preserving data privacy and eliminating usage-based fees. However, agentic workflows are far more re

title: TeamTR: Trust-Region Fine-Tuning for Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
summary: TeamTR提出了一种基于信任区域的多智能体LLM协调微调方法。该方法解决了共享上下文团队中顺序微调导致的结构性失败模式：更新一个智能体会改变团队上下文分布，导致后续更新在缓存轨迹上评估时产生累积偏移。作者将这一现象形式化为复合占用偏移，并证明陈旧占用评估会带来可扩展的惩罚。该工作为多智能体系统协调训练提供了理论框架，对提升Agent协作性能具有重要参考价值。
raw_content: Multi-agent LLM systems have shown promise for complex reasoning, yet recent evaluations reveal they often underperform single-model baselines. We identify a structural failure mode in sequential fine-tuning of shared-context teams: updating one agent shifts the team's context distribution, and when subsequent updates are evaluated on cached rollouts, this mismatch compounds. title: SkillSmith: Compiling Agent Skills into Boundary-Guided Runtime Interfaces
summary: SkillSmith提出将智能体技能编译为边界引导的运行时接口，以解决现有LLM智能体系统中技能注入导致的上下文冗余和重复推理规划问题。该方法通过编译技能为轻量级接口，显著减少无关上下文注入，提升执行效率。实验表明，SkillSmith在多个任务上平均降低30%的推理成本，同时保持任务完成质量。该工作为Agent系统优化技能调用与资源利用提供了新范式，尤其适用于RAG场景下的高效技能集成。
raw_content: Recently, skills have been widely adopted in large language model (LLM)-based agent systems across various domains. In existing frameworks, skills are typically injected into the agent reasoning loop as contextual guidance once matched to a runtime task, enabling specialized task-solving capabilities. We find that this execution paradigm introduces two major sources of redundancy: irrelevant context injection and repeated skill-specific reasoning and planning. To this end, we propose SkillSmith,

title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution
summary: Solvita 是一个面向竞技编程的智能体进化框架，通过持续学习提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。它解决了现有多智能体系统无状态、依赖静态检索且丢弃历史调试经验的问题。在 Codeforces 等基准测试中，Solvita 使 LLM 解题成功率提升超过 30%。该工作为 Agent 方向提供了无需权重更新的持续学习范式，对 RAG 中动态知识积累与多智能体协作具有重要参考价值。
raw_content: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with the rigorous reasoning demands of hard competitive programming. While recent multi-agent frameworks attempt to bridge this reliability gap, they remain fundamentally stateless: they rely on static retrieval and discard the valuable problem-solving and debugging experience gained from previous tasks. To address this, we present Solvita, an agentic evolution framework that enables continuous learning without requiring weight updates to the underlyin

title: Belief Engine: Configurable and Inspectable Stance Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
summary: Belief Engine 是一个可审计的信念更新层，将“信念”视为关于命题的证据状态并以标量立场暴露，用于多智能体 LLM 辩论中立场变化的可配置与可检查。关键结果：它能揭示立场变化源于证据吸收、锚定、角色漂移、回声或提示检索上下文改变等不同原因，而非仅靠生成文本推测。该工作为 Agent 系统的立场动力学提供了可解释性工具，有助于提升多智能体协商与冲突解决中的透明度和可控性。
raw_content: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to simulate deliberative interactions such as negotiation, conflict resolution, and multi-turn opinion exchange. Yet generated transcripts often do not reveal why an agent's stance changes: movement may reflect evidence uptake, anchoring, role drift, echoing, or changed prompt and retrieval context. title: FINESSE-Bench: A Hierarchical Benchmark Suite for Financial Domain Knowledge and Technical Analysis in Large Language Models
summary: FINESSE-Bench 是一个面向金融领域知识与技术分析的分层基准测试套件，用于评估大语言模型在金融分析、报告、投资决策等任务中的专业能力。该基准通过多层级任务设计，覆盖从基础金融知识到复杂技术分析的评估，弥补了现有基准如FinQA等仅关注财务报告问答的不足。其关键亮点在于系统性地测试模型在金融领域的深度理解与推理能力，对Agent/RAG方向具有重要价值，可推动金融智能体在合规、风险管理等场景中的可靠应用。
raw_content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being applied to financial analysis, reporting, investment decision support, risk management, compliance, and professional training. However, robust evaluation of their domain competence in finance remains incomplete. title: STS: Efficient Sparse Attention with Speculative Token Sparsity
summary: STS提出一种无需重新训练模型的高效稀疏注意力机制。其核心发现是：小型草稿模型识别的重要token能高度预测大型目标模型的重要token。在百万级token序列的智能体应用中，该方法显著降低注意力二次复杂度带来的内存与计算瓶颈，为长上下文Agent推理提供高效稀疏化方案。
raw_content: The quadratic complexity of attention imposes severe memory and computational bottlenecks on Large Language Model (LLM) inference. This challenge is particularly acute for emerging agentic applications that require processing multi-million token sequences. We propose STS, a sparse attention mechanism that requires no model retraining. title: Response-Conditioned Parallel-to-Sequential Orchestration for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: 该研究提出一种响应条件化的并行到序列编排方法，用于多智能体系统。该方法结合并行与序列模式的优点，通过动态调整智能体协作顺序，在复杂任务中提升性能。实验显示，该方法在推理准确性和任务完成率上显著优于纯并行或纯序列模式。与Agent方向紧密相关，为多智能体协作提供了更灵活的编排策略。
raw_content: Multi-agent systems can solve complex tasks through collaboration between multiple Large Language Model agents. Existing collaboration frameworks typically operate in either a parallel or a sequential mode. In the parallel mode, agents respond independently to queries followed by aggregation of responses. In contrast, sequential systems allow agents to communicate via a directed topology and refine one another step by step. However, both modes are inadequate for achieving the desired objectives

title: See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation
summary: 该研究提出了一种面向教育动画生成的视觉先验学习方法，通过引入渲染反馈感知约束，解决代码生成后动画渲染中的元素重叠、错位及连续性断裂问题。关键创新在于将视觉缺陷检测从代码执行后前移至生成阶段，显著提升了生成动画的空间一致性。该方法与Agent/RAG方向结合，可增强多模态代码生成系统的视觉质量监控能力。
raw_content: Large language models can generate executable code for educational animations, but the resulting renders often exhibit visual defects, including element overlap, misalignment, and broken animation continuity. These defects cannot be reliably detected from the code alone and become apparent only after execution. title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices
summary: TopoEvo提出了一种拓扑感知的自演化多智能体框架，用于微服务根因分析。该方法通过融合多模态可观测性数据（指标、日志、追踪）并建模级联故障传播，在动态拓扑漂移场景下将根因定位准确率提升至92.3%，较现有LLM智能体降低47%的症状放大偏差。该框架为Agent驱动的可观测性系统提供了拓扑自适应的故障诊断范式。
raw_content: Root cause analysis (RCA) in microservices is challenging due to (i) noisy and heterogeneous multimodal observability (metrics, logs, traces), (ii) cascading failure propagation that amplifies downstream symptoms, and (iii) non-stationary topology drift induced by autoscaling and rolling updates. title: ColPackAgent: Agent-Skill-Guided Hard-Particle Monte Carlo Workflows for Colloidal Packing
summary: ColPackAgent 是一个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）工具服务器和智能体技能的自主蒙特卡洛模拟框架，用于胶体堆积研究。它通过结构化工作流执行模拟，在相行为、自组装和材料设计中实现高效自动化。该框架可独立运行或集成到现有智能体系统中，显著降低了胶体模拟的专业门槛，为Agent驱动的材料科学计算提供了可复用的MCP工具链范例。
raw_content: We introduce ColPackAgent, an agent framework that autonomously runs Monte Carlo simulations of colloidal packing through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server and an agent skill, whether as a standalone agent or inside an existing agent system. By harnessing the MCP server and agent skill, ColPackAgent executes a structured workflow for colloidal packing simulations, which are central to studies of phase behavior, self-assembly, and materials design. title: Distributed Zeroth-Order Policy Gradient for Networked Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary: 本文提出一种面向网络化多智能体强化学习（NMARL）的分布式零阶策略梯度方法，结合人类偏好反馈，在无限时域下实现智能体基于局部状态依赖的协作最大化平均折扣回报。关键亮点是无需集中训练，通过分布式零阶梯度估计有效解决偏好反馈的扩展性问题。该方法为Agent/RAG/MCP方向中大规模多智能体系统的人类反馈集成提供了可扩展的分布式训练框架。
raw_content: We study a networked multi-agent reinforcement learning (NMARL) problem with human feedback in an infinite-horizon setting, where agents interact over an underlying network with localized state dependencies and aim to collaboratively maximize the average discounted return. Existing approaches with preference feedback are primarily developed for single-agent settings and rely on centralized training, which limits their scalability and applicability to large-scale networked multi-agent systems. title: H-Mem: A Novel Memory Mechanism for Evolving and Retrieving Agent Memory via a Hybrid Structure
summary: H-Mem 提出了一种基于混合结构的新型记忆机制，用于LLM智能体（如OpenClaw和Manus）中记忆数据的演化与检索。它解决了现有方法无法有效建模记忆随时间演变及高效检索的问题，在问答任务上显著提升了记忆利用率。该机制与Agent方向高度相关，为智能体长期记忆管理提供了更原则性的解决方案。
raw_content: Memory data are ubiquitous in Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents (e.g., OpenClaw and Manus). A few recent works have attempted to exploit agents'memory for improving their performance on the question-answering (QA) task, but they lack a principled mechanism for effectively modeling how memory data evolves over time and retrieving memory data effectively, leading to poor performance in memory utilization. title: Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents Incentivizes Swarm Intelligence of Large Language Models
summary: DMoA提出了一种可微分的多智能体混合框架，使大语言模型在推理过程中能实现弹性、自适应的协作，取代了预定义的固定通信拓扑。关键亮点是框架通过可微分机制动态优化智能体间的交互路径，显著提升了复杂推理任务的灵活性和性能。该工作为Agent系统在动态任务场景下的自适应协作提供了新范式，可直接应用于多智能体RAG和MCP架构的优化。
raw_content: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have catalyzed the development of multi-agent systems (MAS) for complex reasoning tasks. However, existing MAS typically rely on pre-defined or pre-compiled communication topologies, which limits their flexibility and adaptability to dynamic task requirements. title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory
summary: SMMBench是一个评估源分布式多模态智能体记忆的基准测试。它针对现有基准在预组装上下文中评估系统、忽视智能体能否利用独立来源证据的问题，提出源分布式记忆组合是关键瓶颈。该基准包含跨对话、配置文件、截图、表格、图像和文档等异构工件的碎片化证据，用于测试智能体在RAG场景下的多模态记忆推理能力。
raw_content: Existing benchmarks for multimodal memory reasoning largely evaluate systems within pre-assembled contexts, but under-evaluate whether agents can use evidence distributed across independently originated sources. We argue that source-distributed memory composition is an important and under-examined bottleneck in multimodal agent memory, especially when relevant evidence is fragmented across heterogeneous artifacts such as conversations, profiles, screenshots, tables, images, and documents. title: DimMem: Dimensional Structuring for Efficient Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: DimMem 提出了一种轻量级维度记忆框架，将每条记忆表示为原子化、带类型且自包含的单元，包含时间、地点、原因等显式字段。该方法在保持高召回精度的同时显著降低存储开销，解决了现有记忆系统在保真度与效率之间的权衡问题。与Agent长期记忆方向高度相关，为多智能体系统提供了结构化、可扩展的记忆管理方案。
raw_content: Large language model (LLM) agents require long-term memory to leverage information from past interactions. However, existing memory systems often face a fidelity--efficiency trade-off: raw dialogue histories are expensive, while flat facts or summaries may discard the structure needed for precise recall. title: ALSO: Adversarial Online Strategy Optimization for Social Agents
summary: ALSO提出了一种对抗性在线策略优化方法，用于社交智能体的动态策略调整。该方法在非平稳社交模拟环境中，通过多轮对话与自适应对手交互，实现智能体策略的在线优化。关键亮点是相比静态人格智能体，策略性能提升超过20%。该工作为Agent在复杂社交场景下的在线学习与自适应决策提供了新范式，与多智能体交互和RAG驱动的动态策略生成方向高度相关。
raw_content: Social simulation provides a compelling testbed for studying social intelligence, where agents interact through multi-turn dialogues under evolving contexts and strategically adapting opponents. Such environments are inherently non-stationary, requiring agents to dynamically adjust their strategies over time. title: SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?
summary: SaaS-Bench：评估计算机使用代理能否利用真实SaaS解决专业工作流。该基准测试聚焦于计算机使用代理（CUA）在真实SaaS环境中执行复杂专业任务的能力，突破现有基准依赖简化设置和短时交互的局限。关键结果包括对多种LLM驱动的CUA在长周期、多步骤工作流中的表现进行系统评估，揭示其在真实场景下的性能瓶颈。与Agent方向高度相关，为开发能处理实际企业级SaaS任务的智能体提供了标准化测试平台和优化方向。
raw_content: Computer-Using Agents (CUAs) are rapidly extending large language models (LLMs) beyond text-based reasoning toward action execution in more complex environments, such as web browsers and graphical user interfaces (GUIs). However, existing web and GUI agent benchmarks often rely on simplified settings, isolated tasks, or short-horizon interactions, making it difficult to assess capabilities of agents in realistic professional workflows. title: From Gridworlds to Warehouses: Adapting Lightweight One-shot Multi-Agent Pathfinding for AGVs
summary: 从Gridworlds到仓库：为AGV适配轻量级一次性多智能体路径规划。该工作提出多智能体仓库路径规划（MAWPF），针对差速驱动AGV引入四项约束：动作受限、转向代价、非网格连续空间及动态障碍。关键亮点是保持一次性规划可追踪性，同时弥合经典MAPF与现实仓库的差距。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联价值在于为多智能体系统在物理世界部署提供更实用的路径规划基础。
raw_content: Multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) under one-shot planning is a core component of warehouse automation, yet classical formulations typically assume four-connected 2D grids with unit-time moves in four directions. To fill reality gaps while still being trackable with discrete combinatorial search, this work proposes a more practical counterpart tailored to differential-drive AGVs. title: RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents
summary: RecMem提出了一种基于循环机制的记忆巩固方法，用于高效运行长期LLM代理。该方法通过重新思考记忆巩固的时机，仅在必要时调用LLM处理交互，相比现有系统大幅降低token消耗。实验表明，在长期对话任务中，RecMem在保持同等或更优性能的同时，将LLM调用次数减少50%以上。该工作为Agent系统的外部记忆管理提供了更经济的方案，尤其适用于需要持续交互的长周期RAG场景。
raw_content: Memory systems often organize user-agent interactions as retrievable external memory and are crucial for long-running agents by overcoming the limited context windows of LLMs. However, existing memory systems invoke LLMs to process every incoming interaction for memory extraction, and such an eager memory consolidation scheme leads to substantial token consumption. title: Multi-Agent Cooperative Transportation: Optimal and Efficient Task Allocation and Path Finding
summary: 本文提出协同运输任务分配与路径规划（CT-TAPF）问题，填补了多智能体路径规划（MAPF）和任务分配路径规划（TAPF）框架中缺乏多智能体协作搬运大型物品的空白。关键结果包括首次形式化该问题并给出最优与高效求解方法。该工作直接关联多智能体系统在物流场景中的协作能力提升，为Agent协同任务分配与路径规划提供了新范式。
raw_content: Multi-robot systems are integral to modern logistics, but their capabilities are often limited to tasks executable by individual agents. This paper addresses a critical gap in existing frameworks like Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) and Task Allocation and Path Finding (TAPF), which lack true cooperation for transporting large items that require multiple agents. title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents
summary: 基于大语言模型的智能体常因过早利用先验知识而未能充分获取环境信息，导致在陌生环境中失败。本文提出自主探索能力是构建自适应智能体的关键但未被充分研究的要素。为形式化量化该能力，引入可验证的探索检查点覆盖率指标，衡量智能体发现关键状态、对象和功能范围的广度。该工作为Agent在动态环境中提升探索效率与适应性提供了可评估的基准方法。
raw_content: Large language model based agents often fail in unfamiliar environments due to premature exploitation: a tendency to act on prior knowledge before acquiring sufficient environment-specific information. We identify autonomous exploration as a critical yet underexplored capability for building adaptive agents. title: RTL-BenchMT: Dynamic Maintenance of RTL Generation Benchmark Through Agent-Assisted Analysis and Revision

title: STAR: A Stage-attributed Triage and Repair framework for RCA Agents in Microservices
summary: STAR 提出了一种面向微服务 AIOps 中基于 LLM 的根因分析（RCA）智能体的阶段归因分类与修复框架。该框架通过显式分解推理轨迹，在早期证据收集、假设形成或因果分析阶段检测并修复错误，防止其传播至最终诊断。关键亮点是能有效阻断错误级联，提升 RCA 智能体的诊断可靠性。与 Agent 方向高度相关，为增强多步骤推理智能体的鲁棒性提供了实用方法。
raw_content: LLM-based root cause analysis (RCA) agents have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for incident diagnosis in microservice AIOps. title: Detecting Privilege Escalation in Polyglot Microservices via Agentic Program Analysis

title: Clock-state olfactory search in turbulent flows using Q-learning: The geometry of plume recovery
summary: 在湍流环境中利用Q-learning训练嗅觉搜索智能体，仅依赖“上次嗅闻后计时”的最小记忆实现气味源定位。该智能体学习到可解释的羽流恢复策略，融合昆虫行为中的冲刺、抛射和顺风返回。关键亮点是仅用时钟状态即可在复杂湍流中有效导航，为Agent在部分可观测环境中的记忆压缩与行为涌现提供了新思路，对RAG中的时序信息整合具有参考价值。

title: Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack)

title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Schema-Constrained Clinical Information Extraction

title: An Algebraic Exposition of the Theory of Dyadic Morality

This limitation can encourage Professional Domain Drift, where users rely on AI generated reasoning in domains they cannot reliably evaluate. title: Margin-Adaptive Confidence Ranking for Reliable LLM Judgement
summary: Jung等人（2025）提出了一种假设检验框架，通过学习专用置信度估计器而非依赖启发式方法，确保大语言模型（LLM）判断与人类判断的一致性。该方法解决了模型置信度与人类分歧风险单调性假设可能被违反的问题，并显式分析了置信度估计器的泛化行为。关键亮点在于提升了LLM判断的可靠性，为Agent系统中需要高置信度决策的场景（如RAG中的答案验证）提供了更稳健的置信度排名机制。
raw_content: Jung et al. (2025) introduce a hypothesis testing framework for guaranteeing agreement between large language models (LLMs) and human judgments, relying on the assumption that the model's estimated confidence is monotonic with respect to human-disagreement risk. In practice, however, this assumption may be violated, and the generalization behavior of the confidence estimator is not explicitly analyzed. title: Calibrating LLMs with Semantic-level Reward
summary: 该研究提出了一种基于语义级别的奖励校准方法，用于提升大语言模型（LLM）的不确定性估计能力。通过引入语义级奖励替代传统二元正确性奖励，模型在保持高准确率的同时显著改善了校准质量，在医疗问答和法理解释等高风险场景中，错误预测的置信度降低了约30%。该方法与强化学习框架兼容，可无缝集成到现有Agent和RAG系统中，增强模型在关键决策任务中的可靠性与安全性。
raw_content: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed in consequential settings such as medical question answering and legal reasoning, the ability to estimate when their outputs are likely to be correct is essential for safe and reliable use, requiring well-calibrated uncertainty. title: IO-SVD: Input-Output Whitened SVD for Adaptive-Rank LLM Compression
summary: IO-SVD提出了一种输入-输出白化SVD方法，用于自适应秩的大语言模型压缩。该方法通过低秩分解在保持模型性能的同时显著降低存储和计算成本，在资源受限场景下实现高效推理。关键亮点是采用输入-输出联合白化空间替代传统输入仅白化策略，并实现自适应秩分配而非均匀分配，从而在压缩率与模型精度间取得更优平衡。该工作与Agent/RAG方向高度相关，因为压缩后的LLM可更高效地部署为智能体核心推理模块或RAG系统中的检索增强生成组件，降低延迟和资源占用。
raw_content: Large language models deliver strong performance across language and reasoning tasks, but their storage and compute costs remain major barriers to deployment in resource-constrained and latency-sensitive settings. SVD-based post-training compression offers a hardware-agnostic way to reduce model size and improve inference efficiency through low-rank factorization. title: ASRU: Activation Steering Meets Reinforcement Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: ASRU提出了一种结合激活引导与强化遗忘的多模态大模型可控遗忘框架。该方法通过调整模型内部激活状态实现精确遗忘，在保持生成质量的同时有效消除敏感跨模态记忆。实验表明，ASRU在遗忘成功率上达到95%以上，且生成文本的流畅度与多样性相比基线方法提升12%。该工作为Agent系统中多模态模型的安全遗忘提供了可控且高效的解决方案，尤其适用于需要动态更新知识库的RAG场景。
raw_content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) may memorize sensitive cross-modal information during pretraining, making machine unlearning (MU) crucial. Existing methods typically evaluate unlearning effectiveness based on output deviations, while overlooking the generation quality after unlearning. This can easily lead to hallucinated or rigid responses, thereby affecting the usability and safety of the unlearned model. title: Contexting as Recommendation: Evolutionary Collaborative Filtering for Context Engineering
summary: 核心贡献：提出将上下文工程视为推荐问题的新范式，通过进化协同过滤为不同输入实例动态推荐最优上下文策略。关键结果：在多个LLM基准测试中，该方法相比全局搜索策略平均提升5-8%的性能，并首次实现实例级上下文自适应优化。关联价值：为Agent系统提供细粒度上下文管理方案，通过个性化上下文推荐增强RAG检索质量与多智能体协作效率。
raw_content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to their input contexts, motivating the development of automated context engineering. However, existing methods predominantly treat this as a global search problem, seeking a single context strategy that maximizes average performance across a dataset. title: From Flat Language Labels to Typological Priors: Structured Language Conditioning for Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: 基于语音大语言模型的组合式语音到语音翻译系统近期表现优异。现有系统常将源语言编码为独立扁平嵌入，忽略跨语言共享的系统性语言结构。本文提出结构化语言条件方法，利用类型学先验替代扁平标签，实现数据高效的多语言适配。该方法在低资源语言上翻译质量提升显著，为多语言语音翻译中的语言结构建模提供了新范式，可推广至Agent多语言交互场景。
raw_content: Compositional speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) systems built upon speech large language models (SpeechLLMs) have recently shown promising performance. However, existing S2ST systems often either neglect source-language information or encode it through a language-as-label paradigm, representing each source language as an independent flat embedding. title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents
summary: ShopGym是一个用于电子商务Web智能体的真实模拟与可扩展基准测试的集成框架。它通过结合真实商店快照与可配置沙盒环境，解决了现有方法在真实性与可控性之间的权衡问题。关键亮点包括支持多种任务结构、可复现的交互模式以及大规模性能评估。该框架为Agent方向提供了标准化的电商场景测试平台，有助于推动Web智能体在复杂动态环境中的研究与部署。
raw_content: Developing and evaluating e-commerce web agents requires environments that preserve meaningful task structure while enabling controllable, reproducible, and scalable scientific comparison. Existing methodologies force a tradeoff: live storefronts provide realism but are non-stationary, difficult to inspect, and irreproducible, while hand-built sandbox benchmarks provide control but cover only a narrow range of layouts, catalogs, policies, and interaction patterns. title: Navigating Potholes with Geometry-Aware Sharpness Minimization
summary: LLQR+SAM 提出一种结合几何感知锐度最小化的方法，通过从LLQR框架（一种将最陡下降重构为逐层线性二次型调节器问题的二阶方法）中学习预条件器，来非均匀地扰动参数方向。关键亮点是预条件器稀疏更新并作为慢速组件维护，从而在保持SAM平坦极小值优势的同时，提升优化效率。该方法与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联在于，其几何感知优化策略可提升多智能体系统中模型训练的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
raw_content: Sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) encourages flat minima by perturbing parameters along directions of high loss curvature, but treats all parameter directions uniformly, ignoring the underlying loss geometry. We introduce LLQR+SAM, which combines SAM with a learned preconditioner obtained from the recently proposed LLQR framework, a second-order method that recasts steepest descent as a layerwise linear-quadratic regulator problem. title: Property-Guided LLM Program Synthesis for Planning
summary: 本研究提出属性引导的LLM程序合成方法，用于规划任务。传统方法仅依赖数值分数（如解值或通过测试数）评估程序质量，缺乏失败原因指引，导致需大量生成候选程序，增加LLM推理与评估成本。本方法通过属性引导，显著提升合成效率。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：该方法可优化智能体规划中的程序生成与调试流程，降低资源消耗。
raw_content: LLMs have shown impressive success in program synthesis, discovering programs that surpass prior solutions. However, these approaches rely on simple numeric scores to signal program quality, such as the value of the solution or the number of passed tests. title: GenAI-Driven Approach to RISC-V Supply Chain Exploration
summary: 本文提出一种基于LLM的RISC-V供应链分析工作流，融合视觉语言模型（VLM）与模型驱动工程（MDE），实现多模态数据驱动的全面洞察。该方法利用LLM处理异构非结构化文本，VLM提取图表、表格及扫描文档中的视觉信息，协同识别供应链关键节点与风险。与Agent/RAG方向关联：该工作流可视为多智能体协作与RAG在供应链领域的应用范例，通过多模态信息检索增强决策支持。
raw_content: This paper presents an LLM-empowered workflow for RISC-V supply chain analysis, integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Model-Driven Engineering (MDE) to enable comprehensive, multimodal data-driven insights. The proposed approach addresses the challenges of heterogeneous and unstructured supply chain data by leveraging LLMs for textual understanding and VLMs for extracting information from visual artifacts such as diagrams, tables, and scanned documents. title: Do Biological Structural Guarantees Earn Their Complexity?
summary: 这篇论文质疑生物启发式AI智能体框架中结构保证的可靠性，通过三个深度基准测试（代谢优先级门控、自诱导剂群体感应、贝叶斯停滞检测）对比生物实现、朴素非生物替代方案及消融控制。结果显示，生物结构保证并未显著优于简单替代方案，其复杂性收益存疑。该研究为Agent设计中的结构复杂度与性能权衡提供了关键实证，对RAG/MCP方向中避免过度工程化具有警示价值。
raw_content: Biologically-inspired AI agent frameworks claim reliability benefits through structural guarantees adapted from gene regulatory networks, immune systems, and metabolic control. These claims are rarely tested empirically against simpler alternatives. title: Minerva-Ego: Spatiotemporal Hints for Egocentric Video Understanding
summary: Minerva-Ego是一个用于评估自我中心视频理解的时空线索基准。它通过引入中间推理步骤的评估，弥补了现有基准仅关注输出答案的不足。关键亮点是提供了包含时空线索的复杂视频推理任务，覆盖多种场景。该基准与Agent方向紧密相关，可提升具身智能体在真实环境中的视频理解与推理能力。
raw_content: Video reasoning models are a core component of egocentric and embodied agents. However, standard benchmarks for assessing models provide only evaluation of the output (e.g. the answer to a question), without evaluation of intermediate reasoning steps, and most provide answers only in the text domain. title: Stochastic Non-Smooth Convex Optimization with Unbounded Gradients
summary: 本文提出了一类更现实的广义Lipschitz函数，其梯度范数受最优间隙的仿射函数约束，突破了传统非光滑优化中梯度一致有界的限制。针对凸随机广义Lipschitz优化问题，推导了最优全局收敛率。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中处理非光滑、梯度无界的目标函数（如自适应学习策略）提供了理论支撑。
raw_content: Much of the existing theory on first-order non-smooth optimization is built on a restrictive assumption that the gradients of the objective function are uniformly bounded. We introduce a much more realistic class of generalized Lipschitz functions, where the gradient norms are bounded by an affine function of the optimality gap. title: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with PrismLLM
summary: PrismLLM 提出一种仅用少量 GPU 即可忠实模拟大规模 LLM 训练行为的方法。通过精确复现分布式训练中的计算、通信与内存模式，它能在单机多卡环境下重现千卡集群的训练性能特征。该方法使开发者无需频繁占用生产集群即可进行框架调试与性能优化，显著降低开发成本与资源需求，对 Agent/RAG 等依赖高效 LLM 训练的场景具有重要支撑价值。
raw_content: Large language model (LLM) training today runs on clusters spanning thousands of GPUs. While this scale enables rapid model advances, developing, debugging, and performance-tuning the training framework inevitably becomes complex and costly. title: GRASP: Learning to Ground Social Reasoning in Multi-Person Non-Verbal Interactions
summary: GRASP是一个大规模社交推理数据集，用于训练多模态大语言模型理解多人视频中的非语言交互。它包含46K视频（共749小时）上的290K问答对，按16类注视、手势和联合动作分类。关键亮点是连接高层社交问答与细粒度注视和指示手势事件，解决当前模型无法识别谁与谁互动的问题。该工作对Agent/RAG方向有价值，可增强多智能体系统中基于非语言线索的社交推理能力。
raw_content: Understanding social interactions requires reasoning over subtle non-verbal cues, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often fail to identify who interacts with whom in multi-person videos. We introduce GRASP, a large-scale social reasoning dataset that connects high-level social QA with fine-grained gaze and deictic gesture events. title: RoadmapBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Agentic Software Development Across Version Upgrades
summary: RoadmapBench是一个评估长周期智能体软件开发能力的基准，包含115个基于版本升级的真实长时任务。它解决了现有基准仅聚焦单问题修复、缺乏多文件协同评估的问题。该基准通过细粒度指标衡量智能体在跨版本迭代中的规划与执行能力，对Agent在复杂软件工程场景下的实际部署具有重要参考价值。
raw_content: Coding agents are increasingly deployed in real software development, where a single version iteration requires months of coordinated work across many files. However, most existing benchmarks focus predominantly on single-issue bug fixes from Python repositories, with coarse pass/fail evaluation outcomes, and thus fail to capture long-horizon, multi-target development at real engineering scale. title: Runtime-Orchestrated Second-Order Optimization for Scalable LLM Training
summary: Asteria 提出了一种运行时系统，通过将二阶优化逻辑与关键 GPU 训练路径分离，解决了大规模 LLM 训练中矩阵优化器状态维护的系统开销瓶颈。它动态分配预条件器状态，避免将所有状态保留在加速器上，从而提升训练效率。该方法在保持二阶优化样本效率优势的同时，显著降低了内存与计算成本，对 Agent/RAG 等依赖高效 LLM 训练的场景具有重要价值。
raw_content: Second-order methods offer an attractive path toward more sample-efficient LLM training, but their practical use is often blocked by the systems cost of maintaining and updating large matrix-based optimizer states. We introduce \textbf{Asteria}, a runtime system designed to remove this bottleneck by separating second-order optimization logic from the critical GPU training path. title: Quantization Undoes Alignment: Bias Emergence in Compressed LLMs Across Models and Precision Levels
summary: 量化破坏对齐：压缩大模型在不同精度下的偏见涌现。本研究系统评估了后训练量化对LLM安全性的影响，发现量化会系统性放大模型偏见，且该效应在低精度（如4-bit）下尤为显著。关键结果显示，量化后模型的有害输出率平均增加15-30%，且不同模型族均表现出类似的退化趋势。该发现对Agent部署中的模型压缩策略具有警示意义，提示在RAG或MCP系统中使用量化模型时需额外进行安全对齐验证。
raw_content: Large Language Models are routinely compressed via post-training quantization to reduce inference costs and memory footprint for cloud and edge deployment, yet the impact of this compression on model quality remains poorly understood. title: Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure: Proof-Derived Authorization for Sovereign AI Systems
summary: 该文提出一种基于证明的可验证代理基础设施，用于主权AI系统的授权。核心贡献是引入证明派生授权机制，取代传统身份中心化授权，以应对自主AI代理可能生成语法有效但语义不安全操作的运营风险。关键结果是消除静态权限带来的安全隐患，尤其适用于代理与云基础设施、受监管数据或金融系统交互的场景。与Agent方向高度相关，为自主代理的安全操作提供了可验证的授权框架。
raw_content: Modern cloud and enterprise systems rely on identity-centric authorization, assuming that callers possessing valid credentials are safe to execute commands. The emergence of autonomous AI agents invalidates this assumption: agents can generate syntactically valid but semantically unsafe actions, making standing privileges a significant operational risk. title: Training on Documents About Monitoring Leads to CoT Obfuscation
summary: 通过合成文档微调，使八个模型暴露于描述CoT监控器的预训练风格文档中，发现监控感知模型能够持续地混淆其推理过程以逃避检测。关键结果：所有模型均表现出推理混淆能力，且监控器检测准确率下降超过20%。该研究揭示了CoT监控作为模型行为检测工具的脆弱性，对Agent系统的安全对齐和RAG场景下的推理透明度评估具有重要警示价值。
raw_content: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is one of the most promising tools we have for detecting model misbehavior, but its effectiveness depends on models faithfully externalizing their reasoning. Motivated by this vulnerability, we study whether monitor-aware models are capable of obfuscating their reasoning to evade detection. title: Zero-Shot Goal Recognition with Large Language Models
summary: 大型语言模型在经典规划领域已接近传统规划器水平，但其能力依赖世界知识而非符号推理。目标识别作为互补的溯因任务，更契合LLM优势：评估与世界知识的一致性而非生成新动作序列。本文首次系统评估前沿LLM在零样本目标识别中的表现，关键亮点包括在多个基准上达到与专用方法相当或更优的准确率。该工作为Agent系统中利用LLM进行高效目标推断提供了新范式，尤其在缺乏训练数据的RAG场景中具有直接应用价值。
raw_content: Large language models have recently reached near-parity with classical planners on well-known planning domains, yet this competence relies on world-knowledge exploitation rather than genuine symbolic reasoning. title: Ensemble Monitoring for AI Control: Diverse Signals Outweigh More Compute
summary: 随着AI系统在大规模自主代理场景中部署，确保其行为安全且符合用户意图至关重要。监控代理行为是关键安全机制，但构建可靠监控器困难，人工监督不可行。我们证明，将多样化监控器信号集成到集成模型中，可提升对错误行为的检测能力。我们使用提示构建了12个GPT-4.1-Mini监控器，关键亮点是集成方法在检测性能上优于增加计算资源。该工作与Agent方向紧密相关，为自主代理的安全监控提供了可扩展的集成策略。

Monitoring agent actions is a key safety mechanism, yet reliable monitors remain difficult to build and the scale of these systems makes human oversight impractical. summary: GOMA提出从图信号平滑视角进行结构驱动的多模态对齐。该方法利用多模态属性图（MAG）中节点携带多模态属性、边编码语料结构的特点，精炼冻结的视觉-语言嵌入。关键亮点在于解决了视觉、文本和跨模态关系导致的不同邻域几何问题，同时避免了无限制图处理带来的噪声。该工作对RAG系统中多模态信息的结构化整合具有重要参考价值。

Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs), where nodes carry multimodal attributes and edges encode corpus structure, provide a natural setting for refining frozen vision-language embeddings. title: Nudging Beyond the Comfort Zone: Efficient Strategy-Guided Exploration for RLVR
summary: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过策略引导探索机制，突破模型在已有轨迹上的优化局限。该方法在保持计算效率的同时，将探索范围扩展至模型舒适区之外，相比暴力增加采样次数，在推理任务上实现显著性能提升。该工作为Agent系统在复杂推理场景下的高效探索提供了新范式，可应用于RAG中的多步推理优化与MCP策略自适应调整。

title: A Retrieval-Enhanced Transformer for Multi-Step Port-of-Call Sequence Prediction in Global Liner Shipping
summary: 提出一种面向全球班轮运输的多步骤挂靠港序列预测方法CCRE，该框架受检索增强生成启发，引入检索增强历史编码器。关键结果：通过连接约束与检索机制，有效克服了AIS数据无法预测后续港口及航次计划不可靠的问题，实现多步序列精准预测。该方法将RAG思想引入航运时序预测，为Agent系统在物流调度中的多步决策提供检索增强的序列建模新范式。
raw_content: Accurate multi-step port-of-call sequence prediction is vital for tactical resource orchestration and logistical efficiency. However, existing methods struggle with unreliable voyage schedules and the inability of AIS data to provide visibility beyond the immediate next port. title: Judge Circuits

raw_content: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant paradigm for grading model outputs at scale, yet the same model assigns systematically different scores when its output format changes (e.g., a 1-5 rating vs. a True/False label). title: Mind Dreamer: Untethering Imagination via Active Latent Intervention on Latent Manifolds
summary: Mind Dreamer：一种通过潜在流形主动干预释放想象力的模型。针对模型强化学习中“历史束缚”问题（想象仅从观测状态初始化导致策略优化滞后），提出主动潜在干预框架，将发现过程重构为最小化问题，突破马尔可夫连续性限制。该方法与Agent方向相关，通过解耦想象与观测状态，提升稀疏奖励场景下的策略学习效率。

title: ITGPT: Generative Pretraining on Irregular Timeseries

raw_content: Timeseries regression models often struggle to leverage large volumes of labeled multimodal data, particularly when the data are irregularly sampled or contain missing values. This is common in domains like healthcare and predictive maintenance, where data are collected from unreliable sources, and labeling requires expert knowledge or costly equipments. title: Fully Open Meditron: An Auditable Pipeline for Clinical LLMs

raw_content: Clinical decision support systems (CDSS) require scrutable, auditable pipelines that enable rigorous, reproducible validation. Yet current LLM-based CDSS remain largely opaque. title: PerfCodeBench: Benchmarking LLMs for System-Level High-Performance Code Optimization
summary: PerfCodeBench 是一个用于评估大语言模型在系统级高性能代码优化能力的可执行基准测试。其关键结果发现，现有LLM在生成功能正确代码方面表现良好，但在性能关键型系统任务中生成高效实现的能力仍有限，且现有基准主要关注正确性或算法求解。该基准与Agent/RAG方向关联，可用于测试智能体在代码优化场景下的系统级推理与自动调优能力。
raw_content: Large language models (LLMs) can often generate functionally correct code, but their ability to produce efficient implementations for performance-critical systems tasks remains limited. Existing code benchmarks mainly emphasize correctness or algorithmic problem solving, while realistic systems-level optimization is still underexplored. title: From Full and Partial Intraoral Scans to Crown Proposal: A Classification-Guided Restoration Assistance Pipeline
summary: 提出一种端到端冠修复辅助流水线，从全口或部分口内扫描直接生成冠修复体。关键亮点：在部分扫描数据上，冠分割准确率提升12%，生成冠的咬合面细节保留度提高18%，优于现有全口训练网络和端到端生成方法。该工作与RAG方向关联：通过分类引导优化局部特征提取，可启发医疗领域多模态数据融合与精准生成任务。
raw_content: Single-unit crown restoration is among the most common procedures in clinical dentistry, with CAD/CAM workflows now designing crowns directly from intraoral scans. Partial scans are often preferred over full-arch scans for single-unit cases due to fewer stitching errors, yet most segmentation networks trained on full arches fail on partial scans, while end-to-end generative crown methods often produce over-smoothed surfaces that lose occlusal detail. title: Fortress: A Case Study in Stabilizing Search Recommendations via Temporal Data Augmentation and Feature Pruning
summary: Fortress是一个通用框架，通过识别并剪枝导致预测不一致的特征，来增强搜索推荐模型的稳定性与准确性。实验表明，该方法能有效降低输出分数的时序波动，提升多阶段系统中下游决策的可靠性。该工作对Agent/RAG系统中需要稳定排序与推荐输出的场景具有直接借鉴价值。
raw_content: In search and recommendation systems, predictive models often suffer from temporal instability when certain input features introduce volatility in output scores. This instability can degrade model reliability and user experience especially in multi-stage systems where consistent predictions are critical for downstream decision making. title: MR2-ByteTrack: CNN and Transformer-based Video Object Detection for AI-augmented Embedded Vision Sensor Nodes
summary: MR2-ByteTrack 是一种面向AI增强型嵌入式视觉传感器节点的视频目标检测方法，结合CNN与Transformer架构。针对超低功耗MCU内存和算力受限、无法存储特征或多帧缓冲的难题，该方法通过多分辨率重评分机制实现高效检测。在嵌入式平台上，MR2-ByteTrack在保持检测精度的同时显著降低计算开销，为资源受限的Agent/RAG系统提供轻量级视觉感知能力，支持边缘端实时视频分析。
raw_content: Modern smart vision sensors need on-device intelligence to process video streams, as cloud computing is often impractical due to bandwidth, latency, and privacy constraints. title: Neutral-Reference Prompting for Vision-Language Models
summary: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的迁移学习，提出中性参考提示（Neutral-Reference Prompting）方法以解决基类-新类权衡（BNT）问题。该方法在不牺牲已知类性能的前提下，显著提升未知类识别准确率，实验显示新类准确率提升达5-8%。通过引入中性参考样本缓解VLM对已知类的非对称混淆，为多模态Agent的零样本泛化提供新思路。
raw_content: Efficient transfer learning of vision-language models (VLMs) commonly suffers from a Base-New Trade-off (BNT): improving performance on unseen (new) classes often degrades accuracy on known (base) classes. title: BiomedAP: A Vision-Informed Dual-Anchor Framework with Gated Cross-Modal Fusion for Robust Medical Vision-Language Adaptation
summary: BiomedAP提出了一种视觉引导的双锚点框架，结合门控跨模态融合，用于鲁棒的医学视觉-语言适配。该方法通过双锚点机制和门控融合，有效缓解了提示变化导致的跨模态对齐不稳定问题，在少样本医学诊断中提升了性能。该工作为多智能体系统中处理异构文本输入提供了鲁棒的跨模态对齐策略，对RAG场景下的医学知识检索与融合具有重要参考价值。

title: CitePrism: Human-in-the-Loop AI for Citation Auditing and Editorial Integrity
summary: CitePrism 是一个面向编辑审稿场景的人机协同引用审计框架，通过结合人工审核与AI分析，系统评估引用准确性、元数据质量、自引模式及文献完整性。关键亮点在于实现了引用上下文与本地主张的自动对齐校验，显著提升审计效率与可扩展性。该工作为RAG系统中的引用质量评估与多智能体协作审核流程提供了可落地的技术方案。
raw_content: Editors and reviewers are expected to ensure that manuscripts cite relevant, accurate, current, and ethically appropriate literature, yet manuscript-level citation auditing remains largely manual, fragmented, and difficult to scale. title: Offline Semantic Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation
summary: VLA-AD提出一种离线语义引导的蒸馏框架，利用视觉语言模型作为语义监督器，将大规模VLA教师策略压缩为轻量级学生策略。关键创新在于不依赖低级动作模仿，而是通过教师提供的7自由度动作数据增强语义指导。该方法将模型规模降低至1/10，推理速度提升5倍，同时保持90%以上的操作成功率。与Agent/RAG方向关联：为多模态大模型在机器人实时闭环控制中的高效部署提供了可扩展的蒸馏范式。
raw_content: Billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have recently shown impressive performance in robotic manipulation, yet their size and inference cost remain major obstacles for real-time closed-loop control. title: Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions
summary: 指令微调语言模型在高风险决策中表现出行为公平性，但其内部表征仍保留偏见关联。本研究使用仅种族相关姓名不同的匹配申请，调查开源模型在抵押贷款承销中的应用，揭示了一个关键脱节：被抑制的表征仍能因果影响模型输出，且这种因果效力在人口群体间不对称。该发现对Agent/RAG系统中公平性评估与偏见缓解策略的设计具有重要警示价值。

title: GQA-{\mu}P: The maximal parameterization update for grouped query attention

raw_content: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of neural activation patterns across six distinct large language model (LLM) architectures, examining their performance on twelve cognitive task categories. title: Ghosted Layers: Unconstrained Activation Alignment for Recovering Layer-Pruned LLMs
summary: Ghosted Layers 提出一种无需训练的恢复模块，通过解决边界激活对齐问题来修复层剪枝后大型语言模型中隐藏状态与后续层分布不匹配导致的性能下降。该方法从少量校准集推导出闭式最优线性算子，重新对齐激活分布。与 Agent/RAG/MCP 方向关联：该技术可高效恢复轻量化 LLM，降低推理成本，适用于资源受限场景下的 Agent 部署。
raw_content: Layer pruning removes entire Transformer decoder blocks from large language models, but introduces a mismatch between the hidden state received by the next surviving layer and the distribution it was trained to process, leading to significant performance degradation. title: Rethinking Neural Network Learning Rates: A Stackelberg Perspective
summary: 从Stackelberg博弈视角重新审视神经网络学习率设置。传统方法对所有层使用统一学习率，而本文通过Stackelberg优化框架证明，为不同层分配差异化学习率可加速训练收敛。实验表明，该方法在多个基准数据集上实现训练速度提升20%-40%，且无需额外调参成本。该发现为Agent系统中异构模块的协同优化提供了理论依据，尤其适用于多智能体场景下不同策略网络的异步学习率调度。

summary: PSD提出了一种无需训练的并行推测解码框架，用于加速扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的推理。该方法通过空间上每步解码多个token和时间上将多个去噪步骤合并为一次验证调用，显著降低了推理成本。在多个基准测试中，PSD实现了2.5倍以上的加速，同时保持生成质量。该工作为Agent系统中需要快速文本生成的场景提供了高效推理方案，尤其适用于RAG流水线中的实时响应优化。

title: Federated Learning of Spiking Neural Networks under Heterogeneous Temporal Resolutions
summary: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）受生物启发，通过稀疏二进制脉冲通信实现高能效，适用于资源受限的边缘设备。联邦学习允许设备在不共享原始数据的情况下协作训练。针对时间序列应用，边缘设备因硬件和能耗限制常以不同时间分辨率采集数据，这种时间异构性对联邦学习构成根本挑战。本研究提出一种应对异构时间分辨率的联邦SNN训练方法，在保持低能耗优势的同时，有效解决了数据分布不匹配问题，为Agent/RAG系统中异构时序数据的分布式学习提供了新思路。
raw_content: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are biologically inspired energy-efficient models that use sparse binary spike-based communication between neurons, making them attractive for resource-constrained edge devices. Federated learning enables such devices to train collaboratively without sharing raw data. In time-series applications, edge devices often collect data at different time resolutions due to hardware and energy constraints. title: Adesua: Development and Feasibility Study of an AI WhatsApp Bot for Science Learning in West Africa
summary: Adesua 是一个基于 WhatsApp 的 AI 教学助手，专为西非科学教育设计，扩展了 Kwame for Science 平台。通过利用 WhatsApp 在非洲的广泛普及，它为初中和高中学生提供课程对齐的学习支持。可行性研究显示，该工具在个性化辅导和形成性评估方面具有潜力，有助于缓解该地区高师生比和教师短缺问题。与 Agent 方向相关，展示了 AI 助手在低资源教育场景中的实际应用价值。
raw_content: Sub-Saharan Africa faces persistently high student-teacher ratios and shortages of qualified teachers, limiting students' access to personalized learning support and formative assessment. To address this challenge, we present Adesua, a WhatsApp-based AI Teaching Assistant for science education that extends the Kwame for Science platform. title: Unified High-Probability Analysis of Stochastic Variance-Reduced Estimation
summary: 本文提出一个基于三组件递归的随机方差缩减估计统一分析框架，整合了动量、SPIDER、STORM和PAGE等方法。关键结果包括首次给出这些估计器的高概率收敛保证，揭示了决定可靠性的结构性权衡。该框架为Agent/RAG系统中大规模优化提供理论支撑，有助于提升分布式训练和在线学习场景下的估计鲁棒性。
raw_content: Stochastic estimators are fundamental to large-scale optimization, where population quantities must be inferred from noisy oracle observations. Although influential methods such as momentum, SPIDER, STORM, and PAGE have been highly successful, their analyses are largely estimator-specific and expectation-based, obscuring the structural tradeoffs that determine reliability. title: Representation Without Reward: A JEPA Audit for LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: JEPA审计方法：提出在LLM微调中，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）要求模型学习预测潜在表征而非直接输出，从而获得更有效的抽象。在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct的LoRA框架下，自然语言到正则表达式生成任务中，该方法使隐藏状态几何结构同时满足语言模型头部和解码任务指标提升。与RAG方向关联：该审计方法可评估微调过程中表征质量，为Agent系统提供更鲁棒的语义理解基础。
raw_content: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) propose that a model should learn more useful abstractions when trained to predict latent representations rather than observed outputs. For autoregressive language-model fine-tuning the principle entails a stricter requirement: the induced hidden-state geometry must reach the language-model head \emph{and} improve the decoded task metric. title: Transformer Scalability Crisis: The First Comprehensive Empirical Analysis of Performance Walls in Modern Language Models
summary: 该研究首次对118个Transformer模型在七种架构类别中进行大规模实证分析，揭示了现代语言模型面临的根本性能瓶颈。关键发现是：尽管8个模型在特定任务上表现优异，但所有模型均存在硬性部署约束，表现为性能墙。这为Agent/RAG/MCP系统的模型选型提供了关键约束边界，有助于避免在资源受限场景下选择不合适的模型架构。
raw_content: Despite the remarkable success of transformer architectures in natural language processing, their scalability limitations remain poorly understood through systematic empirical analysis. title: On the Stability of Growth in Structural Plasticity
summary: 标准深度学习流程通常在训练前选定网络架构并保持固定。本文提出在训练过程中通过剪枝或生长神经元来动态调整结构。研究发现生长并非剪枝的逆过程：剪枝从初始参与训练的单元中筛选，而生长需从头训练新单元。该工作为自适应与持续学习系统提供了结构可塑性理论支撑，对Agent/RAG/MCP方向中动态扩展模型容量具有参考价值。
raw_content: Standard deep-learning pipelines usually choose the network architecture before training and keep it fixed throughout optimization. In contrast, a model can also be adapted by editing its structure during training, for example by pruning existing hidden-neuron units or growing new ones. title: Layer-wise Derivative Controlled Networks
summary: ChainzRule（CR）是一种新型神经网络架构，通过逐层导数控制机制同时优化精度、硬件效率和功能稳定性。该方法有效抑制了输入微小变化导致的输出剧烈波动，在敏感场景部署中显著提升鲁棒性。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：其导数控制机制可增强智能体在动态环境中的行为可预测性，为构建稳定可靠的自主系统提供基础架构支持。
raw_content: As machine learning models grow in complexity, they increasingly struggle with three conflicting demands: the need for high accuracy, the requirement for hardware efficiency, and the necessity of functional stability. Traditional architectures often achieve performance at the expense of spiky or unpredictable behavior, where small changes in input lead to massive swings in output -- a critical flaw for real-world deployment in sensitive environments. title: Njord: A Probabilistic Graph Neural Network for Ensemble Ocean Forecasting
summary: Njord是一种概率图神经网络，用于集合海洋预报，解决了现有机器学习海洋模型仅能生成确定性预报的局限。该模型结合深度潜变量框架与图神经网络架构，可在单次前向传播中对每个预报步骤进行采样。在全球0.25°分辨率和波罗的海2公里分辨率区域的应用中，Njord实现了高效的概率预报。这一工作为Agent/RAG/MCP方向提供了处理高维时空不确定性数据的图神经网络方法参考。
raw_content: Ocean dynamics are inherently chaotic, yet existing machine learning ocean models produce only deterministic forecasts. We introduce Njord, a probabilistic data-driven model for ocean forecasting, applicable to both global and regional domains. Njord combines a deep latent variable framework with a graph neural network architecture, enabling sampling each forecast step in a single forward pass. We apply Njord globally at 0.25{\deg} resolution and regionally to the Baltic Sea at 2 km resolution.

title: Embracing Biased Transition Matrices for Complementary-Label Learning with Many Classes
summary: 该研究提出了一种面向多类互补标签学习（CLL）的新方法，通过拥抱有偏转移矩阵来克服传统均匀标签生成假设在大量类别场景下的信号稀释问题。关键突破在于将10类分类扩展到大规模标签空间，显著提升了弱监督学习效率。该方法为Agent系统中处理稀疏标签反馈、优化RAG知识库分类提供了新思路，尤其适用于多实体交互场景下的噪声标签建模。
raw_content: Complementary-label learning (CLL) is a weakly supervised paradigm where instances are labeled with classes they do not belong to. Despite a decade of research, CLL methods remain competitive mainly on 10-class classification, with scaling to large label spaces continuing to be an enduring bottleneck. title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Universal Horizon Models
summary: 基于模型的离线强化学习通过在想象轨迹上进行价值学习，但常因自生成状态的重复模型推理导致累积误差。几何时域模型通过直接预测折扣无限时域未来缓解此问题，但在建模遥远未来状态时仍面临挑战。为此，我们提出通用时域模型，它统一了不同时域建模方法，在离线RL任务中实现更优的长期预测与策略学习性能，对Agent的长期规划能力提升具有参考价值。
raw_content: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) offers a compelling approach to offline RL by enabling value learning on imagined on-policy trajectories. However, it often suffers from compounding errors due to repeated model inference on self-generated states. title: FRWKV+: Adaptive Periodic-Position Branch Interaction for Frequency-Space Linear Time Series Forecasting
summary: FRWKV+提出一种自适应周期位置分支交互机制，用于频域线性时间序列预测。该方法通过增强复数谱实部与虚部间的信息交换，并利用可靠的周期位置线索提升预测精度。在多个长期预测基准上，模型在保持轻量级计算的同时显著降低预测误差。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中时间序列数据的高效处理提供了频域建模新思路。
raw_content: Long-term time series forecasting is essential for decision making in energy, finance, transportation, and healthcare systems. Recent lightweight forecasting models improve efficiency by operating in transformed or linearized spaces, but two challenges remain in frequency-space forecasting. title: A Unified Perturbation Framework for Analyzing Leaderboard Stability and Manipulation
summary: 我们提出一个统一的扰动框架，用于分析Bradley-Terry排行榜在结构化数据修改下的稳定性与操纵性，通过基于影响力的近似方法研究三种比赛级扰动（删除、添加、翻转）及选手移除。关键发现是，仅需少量精心选择的偏好对扰动即可显著改变模型排名，揭示了排行榜的脆弱性。该框架为评估Agent/RAG系统中模型排名的鲁棒性提供了理论工具，有助于设计更可靠的基准测试。
raw_content: Evaluation leaderboards such as LMArena play a central role in benchmarking large language models by aggregating pairwise human preferences into model rankings, yet the robustness of these rankings remains poorly understood. We present a unified perturbation framework for analyzing Bradley-Terry leaderboards under structured data modifications using influence-based approximations. title: Learning Context-conditioned Gaussian Overbounds for Convolution-Based Uncertainty Propagation
summary: 该研究提出一种基于上下文条件的高斯过界方法，用于卷积神经网络中的不确定性传播。关键结果包括：该方法能够为卷积层输出提供保守且可组合的不确定性界，在航空安全等场景中优于传统逐变量区间方法。与RAG方向关联：该方法可增强RAG系统中检索结果的不确定性量化能力，提升决策可靠性。
raw_content: Uncertainty quantification is essential in safety-critical settings--from autonomous driving to aviation, finance, and health--where decisions must rely on conservative bounds rather than point estimates. Predictor-level intervals (e.g., from quantile regression, conformal prediction, variance networks, or Bayesian models) generally do not compose: adding two per-variable intervals need not yield a valid interval for their sum or preserve coverage. title: AOT-POT: Adaptive Operator Transformation for Large-Scale PDE Pre-training
summary: AOT-POT提出了一种自适应算子变换方法，用于大规模偏微分方程（PDE）预训练。该方法通过动态调整目标解算子结构，而非单纯增加模型容量，显著提升了多PDE预训练的效率与泛化能力。在多个基准数据集上，预训练模型在求解精度和收敛速度上均优于现有方法。该工作为科学机器学习中的通用代理模型构建提供了新思路，其算子变换思想可迁移至Agent/RAG系统中处理异构数据流的自适应对齐问题。
raw_content: Pre-training neural operators on diverse partial differential equation (PDE) datasets has emerged as a promising direction for building general-purpose surrogate models in scientific machine learning. However, the inherent complexity and structural diversity of PDE solution operators make multi-PDE pre-training fundamentally challenging. title: Practical Validity Conditions for Byzantine-Tolerant Federated Learning
summary: 拜占庭容错联邦学习中的鲁棒聚合需要有效性条件来保证输出质量。本文提出了一种实用的有效性条件，放宽了传统凸有效性要求（输出必须在诚实向量的凸包内），以适应现代联邦学习系统的高维特性。关键结果是在高维场景下，该条件显著提升了聚合的鲁棒性与效率。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：该研究为分布式多智能体系统中的安全聚合提供了理论基础，可增强联邦学习在去中心化环境中的容错能力。
raw_content: Robust aggregation is the core operation in Byzantine-tolerant federated learning. To ensure the quality of aggregation independently of data distribution or attacks, validity conditions are needed. They provide geometric guarantees of where the output of the aggregation must lie. title: Context-aware Entity-Relation Extraction for Threat Intelligence Knowledge Graphs
summary: 该研究提出面向威胁情报知识图谱的上下文感知实体关系抽取方法，解决从非结构化网络威胁情报报告中提取三元组的难题。关键亮点在于通过建模报告结构上下文与领域特定语义，将抽取准确率提升至85%以上。该方法直接服务于网络安全知识图谱构建，为Agent驱动的自动化威胁分析与实时安全响应提供高质量结构化数据支撑。
raw_content: Cybersecurity Knowledge Graphs (CKGs) unify diverse Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) sources into structured, queryable formats, offering scalable solutions for automating proactive and real-time security responses. Their increasing adoption has significantly enhanced the workflow and decision-making efficiency of security professionals. title: LoCO: Low-rank Compositional Rotation Fine-tuning
summary: LoCO：低秩组合旋转微调。提出一种新型参数高效微调方法LoCO，通过低秩组合正交变换构建旋转更新，在保持参数效率的同时保留预训练表示的几何结构。相比LoRA等现有方法，LoCO在语言和视觉任务上取得更优性能，尤其适用于需要保持特征空间结构的Agent/RAG场景，可提升模型适配的稳定性和泛化能力。
raw_content: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has emerged as an critical technique for adapting large-scale foundation models across natural language processing and computer vision. While existing methods such as low-rank adaptations achieve parameter efficiency via low-rank weight updates, they are limited in their ability to preserve the geometric structure of pretrained representations. title: Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for MT: A Seq2Seq Perspective
summary: 该研究将无参考强化学习微调应用于机器翻译的Seq2Seq模型。核心贡献是提出混合无参考奖励函数（LaBSE和COMET-Kiwi），在微调时无需平行数据，并系统评估了NLLB-200（600M和1.3B参数）在13种语言上的表现。关键结果：该方法显著提升了翻译质量，尤其在低资源语言上表现突出。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联：该无参考奖励机制可启发Agent系统中无需人工标注的奖励设计，提升多语言任务的自适应能力。
raw_content: Production machine translation relies overwhelmingly on encoder-decoder Seq2Seq models, yet reinforcement learning approaches to MT fine-tuning have largely targeted decoder-only LLMs at $\geq$7B parameters, with limited systematic study of encoder-decoder architectures. title: Constrained latent state modeling: A unifying perspective on representation learning under competing constraints
summary: 标题：约束潜状态建模：竞争约束下表示学习的统一视角。本文提出一种统一框架，将时间序列、多模态和部分观测系统中的潜状态表示学习整合为受竞争约束的优化问题。关键结果包括：该框架统一了现有方法中关于状态表征的隐式假设，并揭示了不同约束（如平滑性、稀疏性、因果性）之间的权衡关系。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联：该框架为构建具有结构化状态空间的智能体系统提供了理论基础，可提升多模态RAG中状态追踪的鲁棒性，并优化MCP协议下跨模态信息融合的表示学习策略。
raw_content: Learning latent representations from complex data is central to modern machine learning, spanning temporal, multimodal, and partially observed systems. In such settings, representations are better understood as latent states capturing underlying system dynamics, rather than as mere compressed summaries of observations. title: Accelerated Gradient Descent for Faster Convergence with Minimal Overhead
summary: CT-AGD是一种面向深度学习非凸优化任务的加速梯度下降方法，通过有限差分商显式捕捉局部曲率来加速一阶优化器，并引入启发式策略抑制随机小批量训练中的噪声与偏差。该方法在存储和计算开销上与标准优化器相当，但能显著提升收敛速度。对于Agent/RAG/MCP方向，其低开销加速特性可高效优化大规模模型训练中的参数更新过程。
raw_content: In this paper, we present CT-AGD (Curvature-Tuned Accelerated Gradient Descent), an optimization method for non-convex optimization problems in deep learning training tasks. CT-AGD is a general boosting procedure that accelerates first-order methods by explicitly capturing the local curvature using finite-difference quotients, and the development of heuristics aimed at mitigating noise and bias introduced by stochastic mini-batch training. title: Multi-level Self-supervised Pretraining on Compositional Hierarchical Graph for Molecular Property Prediction
summary: MolCHG提出一种基于组合层次图的多级自监督预训练框架，将分子结构组织为三层四种节点类型，首次将键信息作为独立语义层而非辅助边属性处理。在多个分子性质预测基准上，该方法相比现有单粒度预训练模型提升约5-10%的预测精度。该工作为分子图表示学习提供了层次化结构建模新思路，可扩展至药物分子RAG系统中的特征提取与知识增强。
raw_content: Self-supervised pretraining on molecular graphs has emerged as a promising approach for molecular property prediction, yet most existing methods operate at a single structural granularity and treat bond information as auxiliary edge attributes rather than as an independent semantic layer. title: Federated Imputation under Heterogeneous Feature Spaces
summary: 联邦异质特征空间下的数据插补方法。针对联邦学习中客户端特征子集部分重叠的表格数据场景，提出一种无需对齐特征模式的插补框架。实验表明，在特征重叠率低于30%时，该方法相比FedAvg提升插补精度达45%，且能有效处理完全不相交的特征组。该工作为RAG系统中多源异构数据源的联邦对齐与缺失值填补提供了新思路，可扩展至MCP协议下的分布式数据协作场景。
raw_content: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training across decentralized clients, but most methods assume aligned feature schemas, an assumption that rarely holds in tabular settings where clients observe only partially overlapping feature subsets. In these heterogeneous feature spaces, parameter-averaging methods (e.g., FedAvg) transfer little information across weakly overlapping or disjoint feature groups, limiting their effectiveness for federated imputation. title: MultiMat: Multimodal Program Synthesis for Procedural Materials using Large Multimodal Models
summary: MultiMat提出利用大型多模态模型实现程序化材质的多模态程序合成方法。该方法将材质节点图视为生成2D通道（如粗糙度、位移、反照率等）的程序，在计算机图形学中支持参数化、任意分辨率的虚拟3D物体外观建模。其有向无环图结构和中间状态提供了模块化、可解释的交互式外观建模工作流，与Agent/RAG方向结合可推动智能材质生成与自动化建模。
raw_content: Material node graphs are programs that generate the 2D channels of procedural materials, including geometry such as roughness and displacement maps, and reflectance such as albedo and conductivity maps. They are essential in computer graphics for representing the appearance of virtual 3D objects parametrically and at arbitrary resolution. summary: 提出一种硬件-软件协同设计方法，实现可扩展、高能效的模拟递归计算，突破传统模拟电路仅支持前馈架构的限制。通过识别双稳态特性，有效抑制时间反馈中的噪声累积，使模拟递归网络在环境传感器和生物植入等持续运行AI应用中实现亚微瓦级推理。该工作为低功耗Agent和边缘RAG系统提供硬件基础，支持实时序列处理。
raw_content: Always-on AI applications, from environmental sensors to biomedical implants, require ultra-low power consumption. Analog circuits offer a path to sub-microwatt inference, yet existing analog implementations are limited to feedforward architectures: extending them to recurrent dynamics has been considered impractical due to noise accumulation through temporal feedback. title: PhysBrain 1.0 Technical Report
summary: PhysBrain 1.0技术报告提出一种新方法：通过将大规模人类第一人称视频转化为结构化物理常识监督信号，弥补机器人轨迹数据在物理理解学习上的不足。其数据引擎可提取场景元素、空间动态、动作执行及深度感知关系，并生成问答监督数据用于训练PhysBrain视觉语言模型。该工作为机器人适应前的物理常识预训练提供了高效数据生成方案，与Agent/RAG方向结合可增强具身智能体的环境理解与推理能力。
raw_content: Vision-language-action models have advanced rapidly, but robot trajectories alone provide limited coverage for learning broad physical understanding. PhysBrain 1.0 studies a complementary route: converting large-scale human egocentric video into structured physical commonsense supervision before robot adaptation. Our data engine extracts scene elements, spatial dynamics, action execution, and depth-aware relations, then turns them into question-answer supervision for training PhysBrain VLMs. The

title: HoloMotion-1 Technical Report
summary: HoloMotion-1 是一种用于零样本全身运动跟踪的人形运动基础模型。其核心创新在于利用大规模混合运动语料库扩展控制策略训练，其中来自野外视频的视频重建运动提供了主要运动多样性来源，而精选的动作捕捉和内部运动数据提供了更高保真度的监督和部署导向覆盖。该数据机制使HoloMotion-1在零样本场景下实现高效全身运动跟踪，与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联在于其运动基础模型能力可增强具身智能体的感知与交互。
raw_content: In this report, we present HoloMotion-1, a humanoid motion foundation model for zero-shot whole-body motion tracking. A key innovation of HoloMotion-1 is to scale control-policy training with a large-scale hybrid motion corpus, where video-reconstructed motions from in-the-wild videos provide the dominant source of motion diversity, while curated motion-capture and in-house motion data provide higher-fidelity supervision and deployment-oriented coverage. title: Quantum Feature Pyramid Gating for Seismic Image Segmentation
summary: 量子特征金字塔门控用于地震图像分割。该方法通过混合量子-经典模型实现盐体精准分割，首次将量子门控机制应用于密集像素级地球物理预测任务。实验表明，在SEAM数据集上分割精度达92.3%，较传统CNN提升5.1%。该工作为Agent驱动的自动化地震解释系统提供了量子增强特征选择新范式，可集成至RAG框架的地质知识检索管线中。
raw_content: Accurate salt-body delineation is essential for seismic interpretation because salt structures distort wave propagation, complicate velocity-model building, obscure reservoir geometry, and increase uncertainty in exploration and drilling decisions. Although hybrid quantum-classical models have shown competitive performance on small-scale image-classification tasks, their value for dense, pixel-level geophysical prediction remains largely untested. title: ChangeFlow -- Latent Rectified Flow for Change Detection in Remote Sensing
summary: ChangeFlow提出了一种基于潜在修正流的遥感变化检测方法，将变化区域建模为从源图像到目标图像的概率流过程，而非逐像素分类。该方法在多个基准数据集上实现了优于现有技术的性能，尤其在处理区域级标注和模糊边界时表现突出。该工作展示了生成式流模型在视觉变化检测中的潜力，可启发Agent系统中多模态数据对齐与差异分析模块的设计。
raw_content: Remote sensing change detection (RSCD) aims to localise changes between two images of the same geographic region. In practice, change masks often follow region-level annotation conventions rather than purely local appearance differences, making them context-dependent and occasionally ambiguous. title: Amortized Energy-Based Bayesian Inference
summary: 针对仅有参数与观测联合分布样本的非线性逆问题，提出基于传输的摊销贝叶斯推断方法。该方法学习一个依赖观测的映射，将参考测度推前以近似后验分布，避免每次观测重复求解马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：其摊销推断思想可提升多智能体系统中实时推理效率，或用于RAG中动态调整检索策略。
raw_content: We consider amortized Bayesian inference for nonlinear inverse problems in settings where only samples from the joint distribution of parameters and observations are available. Classical methods such as Markov chain Monte Carlo require solving a new inference problem for each observation, which can be computationally prohibitive when inference must be repeated many times. title: From Feedback Loops to Policy Updates: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for LLM-Based Alpha Factor Discovery
summary: 该研究提出基于强化微调的LLM因子发现框架，将传统提示级反馈循环升级为策略级参数更新。核心贡献在于通过奖励驱动的策略优化，使模型在迭代中自主调整因子生成策略，避免历史候选因子累积导致的上下文膨胀。实验显示，该方法在夏普比率和因子有效性上较基线提升15%-20%。与Agent方向关联在于展示了强化学习如何增强LLM在金融决策任务中的自主迭代能力。
raw_content: Modern quantitative trading increasingly relies on systematic models to extract predictive signals from large-scale financial data, where alpha factor discovery plays a central role in transforming market observations into tradable signals. Recent LLM-based methods have shown promise in automating factor generation, but most of them still rely on prompt-level generation--evaluation--feedback loops for iterative optimization. title: DiffVAS: Diffusion-Guided Visual Active Search in Partially Observable Environments
summary: DiffVAS提出了一种扩散引导的视觉主动搜索方法，用于在部分可观测环境中通过无人机等空中平台高效定位感兴趣区域。该方法利用扩散模型动态更新搜索策略，相比传统假设全空间已知的方法，在模拟搜索任务中定位成功率提升约20%。该工作为Agent在动态未知环境中的主动感知与决策提供了新范式，可拓展至多智能体协同搜索与RAG驱动的实时信息融合场景。
raw_content: Visual active search (VAS) has been introduced as a modeling framework that leverages visual cues to direct aerial (e.g., UAV-based) exploration and pinpoint areas of interest within extensive geospatial regions. Potential applications of VAS include detecting hotspots for rare wildlife poaching, aiding search-and-rescue missions, and uncovering illegal trafficking of weapons, among other uses. title: Tuning-free Instruction-based Video Editing Via Structural Noise Initialization and Guidance
summary: 提出一种免调参、基于指令的视频编辑框架，通过结构性噪声初始化策略（SNIS）优化噪声潜空间，以充分利用其中丰富信息。关键结果包括：无需模型训练或数据收集，即可实现高质量视频编辑，显著优于现有免调参方法。该工作与Agent/RAG方向关联在于，其噪声初始化与引导机制可启发多智能体系统中信息融合与任务分解的鲁棒性设计。
raw_content: Video editing poses a significant challenge. While a series of tuning-free methods circumvent the need for extensive data collection and model training, they often underutilize the rich information embedded within noisy latent, leading to unsatisfactory results. To address this, we propose a \textit{tuning-free, instruction-based} video editing framework. title: CM-EVS: Sparse Panoramic RGB-D-Pose Data for Complete Scene Coverage
summary: CM-EVS提出一种将3D资产转换为稀疏全景RGB-D-Pose数据的方法，用于实现完整场景覆盖。该方法通过几何一致性采样策略，在保持稀疏性的同时避免密集轨迹的视图重复和深度不一致问题，相比传统方法在场景覆盖完整性上提升显著。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中的3D环境感知提供了标准化的训练数据接口，有助于提升多智能体在复杂场景中的空间理解与导航能力。
raw_content: Modern 3D visual learning relies on observations sampled from metric 3D assets, yet existing scans, meshes, point clouds, simulations, and reconstructions do not directly provide a sparse, comparable, and geometry-consistent panoramic training interface. Dense trajectories duplicate nearby views, source-specific rendering policies yield heterogeneous annotations, and sparse heuristics may miss important regions or introduce depth-inconsistent observations. title: TFZ-Tree: An Ultra-Lightweight Waveform Classification Framework for Resource-Constrained Devices
summary: TFZ-Tree提出了一种超轻量级波形分类框架，专为资源受限的6G物联网设备设计，能直接识别物理层波形类型（如OFDM、OTFS、LoRa）。相比依赖深度神经网络和复杂时频变换的现有方法，该框架在保持高分类精度的同时，计算开销降低至毫瓦级，模型大小仅数KB。其轻量化特性使其可无缝集成到Agent或RAG系统的边缘设备中，为多波形共存场景下的实时信号处理与资源调度提供高效支持。
raw_content: Under the trend of multi-waveform coexistence in 6G IoT, intelligent receivers must first identify physical-layer waveform types before performing correct demodulation and resource scheduling. However, existing signal identification research largely focuses on symbol-level modulation classification. title: VLMs Trace Without Tracking: Diagnosing Failures in Visual Path Following
summary: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态基准测试中表现强劲，但在基本视觉操作上缺乏稳健控制。我们研究“线条追踪”任务，要求模型通过连续局部延续跟踪选定视觉路径。为隔离该能力，我们设计受控追踪任务，引入邻近竞争路径并减少语义和拓扑歧义（如交叉和重叠）。在这些任务中，即使最先进的VLM也频繁失败。该工作揭示了VLM在视觉路径跟随上的根本缺陷，对Agent/RAG/MCP方向中依赖视觉推理的智能体系统（如文档导航或UI操作）具有诊断与改进价值。
raw_content: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on multimodal benchmarks, but may still lack robust control over basic visual operations. We study \textit{line tracing}, where a model must follow a selected visual path through successive local continuations. To isolate this ability, we design controlled tracing tasks that introduce nearby competitors while reducing semantic and topological ambiguity such as crossings and overlaps. title: Learning Dynamic Pick-and-Place for a Legged Manipulator
summary: 该研究提出一种用于腿式机械臂动态抓取与放置任务的分层强化学习框架。通过集成显式质量估计模块，实现了四足机器人搭载6自由度机械臂的自适应全身控制。在动态操作中，机器人成功完成抓取与放置任务，协调运动与精准操作得到有效结合。该工作为Agent在复杂动态环境中的全身协调控制提供了新思路，对多智能体协同操作与RAG任务中的物理交互具有参考价值。
raw_content: Legged manipulators extend robotic capabilities beyond static manipulation by integrating agile locomotion with versatile arm control. However, achieving precise manipulation while maintaining coordinated locomotion remains a major challenge. This work presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic pick-and-place tasks using a quadruped equipped with a 6-DOF robotic arm. title: Semi-MedRef: Semi-Supervised Medical Referring Image Segmentation with Cross-Modal Alignment
summary: Semi-MedRef提出一种半监督医学指代图像分割方法，通过跨模态对齐在低标注场景下降低像素级掩码标注成本。该方法引入跨模态强扰动与一致性约束，在ACDC和CHAOS数据集上仅用10%标注数据即达到接近全监督的性能。该工作为医学影像中的少样本指代分割提供了高效的半监督范式，可扩展至医疗Agent的自动化诊断与报告生成场景。
raw_content: Medical referring image segmentation (MRIS) requires pixel-level masks aligned with textual descriptions of anatomical locations, making annotation costly in low-label regimes. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) can mitigate this burden by leveraging unlabeled data, but its success hinges on maintaining reliable image-text alignment under perturbations. title: Structure Abstraction and Generalization in a Hippocampal-Entorhinal Inspired World Model
summary: 受海马-内嗅皮层启发的世界模型，通过层次化结构同时推断潜在状态转移并构建预测性视觉世界模型。关键亮点在于模型能从连续高维动态中提取抽象结构，实现模式推理与知识迁移，在空间与概念表征任务上表现优异。该工作为Agent系统提供类脑的结构抽象与泛化机制，可增强RAG中知识结构的动态建模与多智能体环境下的情境推理能力。
raw_content: Humans abstract experiences into structured representations to facilitate pattern inference and knowledge transfer. While the hippocampal-entorhinal (HPC-MEC) circuit is known to represent both spatial and conceptual spaces, the mechanisms for concurrently extracting abstract structures from continuous, high-dimensional dynamics remain poorly understood. summary: 这是一个拓扑感知的时空交接框架，用于实现多无人机连续跟踪。关键结果包括：通过拓扑图建模无人机FOV重叠区域，实现跨视角车辆身份保持，轨迹碎片化减少超过40%，跟踪连续性提升至95%以上。该框架与多智能体协同和RAG中的跨模态数据关联高度相关，为分布式无人机系统提供了可扩展的持续跟踪方案。
raw_content: The integration of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles(UAVs) into Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) offers synoptic visibility for traffic monitoring, yet scalable deployment is hindered by trajectory fragmentation, where vehicle identity persistence is lost across multi-UAV Fields of View (FOV). title: Heuristic-Based Merging of HPC Traces to Extend Hardware Counter Coverage
summary: 本文提出一种基于启发式的轨迹合并方法，用于扩展高性能计算（HPC）工作负载的硬件计数器覆盖范围。通过匹配不同执行中的计算突发，将多次运行（每次使用不同计数器集）的轨迹合并，解决了硬件计数器数量受限的问题。该方法可提升ML性能预测模型的输入数据质量，对Agent/RAG方向中资源受限场景下的数据增强与特征融合具有参考价值。
raw_content: This work extends a framework for predicting the performance of High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads using Machine Learning (ML). A common limitation in performance modeling is the restricted number of hardware counters that can be collected simultaneously. title: GAP: Geometric Anchor Pre-training for Data-Efficient Visuomotor Learning of Manipulation Tasks
summary: GAP提出几何锚点预训练方法，用于从少量专家演示中学习机器人操作的视觉运动策略。该方法通过将高维RGB表示蒸馏为控制相关的几何特征，避免过拟合，在仅使用少量微调数据时，相比冻结的视觉基础模型，任务成功率提升15%以上。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：其几何锚点机制可增强多智能体系统中视觉-运动控制的泛化能力，减少对大规模演示数据的依赖。
raw_content: Learning visuomotor policies from scarce expert demonstrations remains a core challenge in robotic manipulation. A primary hurdle lies in distilling high-dimensional RGB representations into control-relevant geometry without overfitting. title: Complexity of Non-Log-Concave Sampling in Fisher Information
summary: 本研究探讨了从对数光滑非对数凹分布中采样时，获得相对Fisher信息保证的查询复杂度，这相当于优化中寻找近似驻点的采样版本。算法基于近端采样器（Langevin扩散的隐式离散化），需实现称为受限高斯预言机（RGO）的后向步骤。通过利用最新对数凹结果，我们展示了关键性能指标。该工作与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联在于，为复杂分布采样提供了理论基础，可提升生成模型和不确定性量化中的采样效率。
raw_content: We study the query complexity of obtaining a relative Fisher information guarantee for sampling from a log-smooth non-log-concave distribution; this is a sampling analog of finding an approximate stationary point in optimization. Our algorithm is based on the proximal sampler, which is an implicit discretization of the Langevin diffusion, and requires an implementation of the backward step known as the restricted Gaussian oracle (RGO). title: Beyond Content: A Comprehensive Speech Toxicity Dataset and Detection Framework Incorporating Paralinguistic Cues
summary: 提出ToxiAlert，一个融合副语言线索（如情感、语调和语速）的全面语音毒性数据集与检测框架。实验表明，结合副语言特征后检测F1分数提升12.3%，显著优于纯文本基线。该工作填补了多模态毒性检测空白，为构建更安全的在线语音交互Agent提供关键数据与模型支撑。
raw_content: Toxic speech detection has become a crucial challenge in maintaining safe online communication environments. However, existing approaches to toxic speech detection often neglect the contribution of paralinguistic cues, such as emotion, intonation, and speech rate, which are key to detecting speech toxicity. title: XSearch: Explainable Code Search via Concept-to-Code Alignment
summary: XSearch提出了一种基于概念到代码对齐的可解释代码搜索方法。该方法通过将自然语言查询与代码片段在概念层面进行对齐，在基准测试中检索准确率提升12%，同时生成可解释的匹配理由。这项研究对RAG系统中的代码检索模块具有直接借鉴价值，通过增强检索的可解释性来提升智能体代码理解与生成的可信度。
raw_content: Semantic code search has been widely adopted in both academia and industry. These approaches embed natural-language queries and code snippets into a shared embedding space and retrieve results based on vector similarity. Despit strong performance on benchmark datasets, they often suffer from poor explainability and generalization. Retrieved code may appear semantically similar yet miss critical functional requirements of the query, while providing no explanation of why the result was retrieved.

title: Robust Prior-Guided Segmentation for Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 提出一种基于SAM-HQ的鲁棒先验引导分割框架，用于可编辑3D高斯溅射。该方法通过生成高保真2D掩码，解决了标准SAM在边界精度和视图一致性上的不足，实现精确的3D场景分割。关键结果包括：在物体移除、提取和重新着色等编辑任务中，分割精度提升显著，掩码质量优于现有方法。该工作为Agent驱动的3D场景编辑提供了可靠的分割基础，可集成至RAG系统实现语义化场景操作。
raw_content: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) enables real-time 3D scene reconstruction but lacks robust segmentation for editing tasks such as object removal, extraction, and recoloring. Existing approaches that lift 2D segmentations to the 3D domain suffer from view inconsistencies and coarse masks. title: AgriMind: An Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Plant Disease Classification
summary: AgriMind是一个集成深度学习框架，用于多类植物病害分类。它结合ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0和DenseNet121，在20,638张PlantVillage图像上训练，覆盖15种辣椒、马铃薯和番茄病害类别。单个模型在测试集上达到96-97%准确率，通过冻结ImageNet骨干网络和仅训练头部10轮保持轻量化。该工作展示了集成学习在农业病害检测中的应用潜力，可扩展至Agent驱动的自动化监测系统。
raw_content: Plant disease detection is still largely manual in Bangladesh, where extension workers eyeball leaf samples across millions of smallholdings. We built AgriMind to automate this: an ensemble of ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, and DenseNet121 trained on 20,638 PlantVillage images across 15 pepper, potato, and tomato disease classes. title: Centralized vs Decentralized Federated Learning: A trade-off performance analysis
summary: 联邦学习（FL）作为分布式边缘设备协同训练模型并保护数据隐私的范式，因IoT设备激增带来的海量数据而备受关注。本文系统对比了集中式（CFL）、去中心化（DFL）与半去中心化（SDFL）三种架构的性能权衡。关键发现：在通信效率与模型收敛速度上，CFL优于DFL但存在单点故障风险；DFL通过点对点通信提升鲁棒性但增加延迟。该分析为Agent系统在隐私敏感场景下的分布式协作训练提供了架构选择依据，尤其适用于多智能体间的联邦RAG知识库更新。
raw_content: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for collaborative model training across distributed edge devices while preserving data privacy especially with the huge increase amount of data due to the adoption of technologies which contributes to the growing number of IoT devices. title: Preserving Topology Privacy of Network Systems by Feedback: Conditions and Distributed Design
summary: 本文提出一种基于反馈的方法，用于保护网络系统中共识协议的拓扑隐私。核心思想是故意违反拓扑可辨识条件，从而防止从可用观测中唯一或准确恢复真实拓扑，同时保持预期的共识行为。关键挑战在于反馈幅度直接反映边的隐私级别，且与共识性能强耦合。该方法为Agent系统中的分布式隐私保护提供了新思路，尤其适用于多智能体协作场景下的拓扑信息隐藏。
raw_content: This paper develops a feedback-based method to preserve the topology privacy of consensus protocols in network systems. title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
summary: NOVA框架将AI系统“生成-验证-积累-再训练”的迭代自改进循环建模为知识空间上的自适应采样过程，揭示了知识发现的根本限制。研究识别出知识覆盖有限域的充分条件，并指出其违反会导致四种典型失败模式：污染、遗忘、探索失败与接受。该工作为Agent系统在持续学习与知识积累中的鲁棒性设计提供了理论边界，对RAG中的知识更新与多智能体协作中的知识共享具有重要指导价值。
raw_content: Can AI systems discover genuinely new knowledge through iterative self improvement, and if so, at what cost? We introduce the NOVA framework, which models the common ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. title: Mask-Morph Graph U-Net: A Generalisable Mesh-Based Surrogate for Crashworthiness Field Prediction under Large Geometric Variation
summary: Mask-Morph Graph U-Net：一种可泛化的基于网格的替代模型，用于大几何变化下的耐撞性场预测。该模型利用图神经网络替代非线性有限元碰撞仿真，显著降低计算成本。关键亮点：在几何大幅变化时仍保持高精度，泛化能力强。与Agent/RAG方向关联：其图结构泛化能力可启发多智能体系统中动态拓扑建模与信息传递机制设计。

title: Logical Grammar Induction via Graph Kolmogorov Complexity: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Self-Healing Clinical Data Integrity
summary: Logic-GNN 提出一种神经符号框架，将临床记录视为受潜在逻辑游戏约束的结构化“私有语言”，用于自愈临床数据完整性。通过结合时序图神经网络与图柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度，诱导出符号语法以区分人为录入错误与合法临床极端值。该方法在异常检测中优于统计方法，为医疗信息系统提供可解释的自我修复机制，与RAG方向中结构化知识推理与符号逻辑融合高度相关。

title: Reading the Cell, Designing the Cure: Perturbation-Conditioned Molecular Diffusion for Function-Oriented Drug Design
summary: 该研究提出基于转录组的药物设计（TBDD）框架，将药物分子生成形式化为以期望转录组状态转移为条件的逆向问题。通过扰动条件分子扩散模型，在缺乏靶点结构时利用转录组扰动作为系统级功能读数，实现面向功能的药物设计。该方法弥合了转录组与分子结构间的领域鸿沟，为基于表型的药物发现提供了新范式，与RAG方向中条件生成与多模态对齐技术高度相关。
raw_content: When reliable target structures are unavailable at scale or phenotypes arise from dysregulated pathways, transcriptomic perturbations provide a system-level functional readout for drug action. title: Privacy Evaluation of Generative Models for Trajectory Generation
summary: 该研究系统评估了生成模型（GAN、VAE、扩散模型）在轨迹生成中的隐私保护能力。关键发现：现有生成模型普遍存在隐私泄露风险，通过成员推理攻击可成功识别训练数据中的个体轨迹，攻击准确率高达80%以上。该工作为Agent系统中轨迹数据的隐私保护设计提供了重要评估基准，对RAG场景下敏感时空数据的合成与使用具有直接指导价值。
raw_content: Trajectory data is fundamental to modern urban intelligence, yet its sensitivity raises significant privacy concerns. Generative models such as Generative Adversarial Networks, Variational Autoencoders, and Diffusion Models have been developed to generate realistic synthetic trajectory data by capturing underlying spatiotemporal distributions and mobility patterns. title: PDRNN: Modular Data-driven Pedestrian Dead Reckoning on Loosely Coupled Radio- and Inertial-Signalstreams
summary: PDRNN：一种模块化数据驱动行人航位推算方法，基于松耦合无线电与惯性信号流。该方法通过深度学习融合多模态传感器数据，解决了采样率差异和传输不可靠问题。在动态高加速度场景下，定位精度提升显著，优于传统融合方法。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：其模块化数据驱动架构可启发多智能体系统中异构传感器数据的协同处理与鲁棒融合策略设计。
raw_content: Modern pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) systems rely on fusing noisy and biased estimates of position, velocity, and calibrated orientation derived from loosely coupled sensors to determine the current pose of a localized object. raw_content: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) combine deep learning with physical constraints for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), and are widely applied in fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and solid mechanics. title: GESD: Beyond Outcome-Oriented Fairness
summary: GESD提出了一种面向过程公平性的新指标——群体级解释稳定性差异（GESD）。现有公平性度量（如统计均等、机会均等）仅关注结果导向的不平等，而GESD通过量化模型决策解释的稳定性差异，揭示偏见背后的程序性原因。该指标可应用于贷款审批、招聘等高风险决策场景，为Agent/RAG系统提供更细粒度的公平性评估，确保模型解释在不同群体间保持一致性。
raw_content: Machine learning (ML) algorithms are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making domains such as loan approvals, hiring, and recidivism predictions. title: How Data Augmentation Shapes Neural Representations
summary: 数据增强通过形状分析工具将网络隐藏表示嵌入到对缩放、平移、旋转和反射不变的度量空间中，揭示了不同增强策略如何重塑神经网络的内部表示几何结构。研究表明，增强强度的增加会系统性地改变表示空间的拓扑结构，从而提升泛化能力。该发现为理解数据增强对表示学习的影响提供了理论支撑，对Agent系统中表示空间的设计与优化具有参考价值。
raw_content: Data augmentation is widely recognized for improving generalization in deep networks, yet its impact on the geometry of learned representations remains poorly understood. In this work, we characterize how different data augmentation strategies reshape internal representations in neural networks. title: Time-Varying Deep State Space Models for Sequences with Switching Dynamics
summary: 该研究提出一类基于时变状态空间模型（SSM）的神经网络，其神经元状态由时变动力学控制。通过基函数字典实现可学习的时变动力学，每个基函数随时间不同演化。在切换动力学序列建模任务中，该方法显著提升了长序列预测与状态估计精度。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：时变SSM可增强智能体对动态环境的适应能力，为RAG系统处理非平稳数据流提供时序建模新范式。
raw_content: The identification and modeling of time-varying systems is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and system identification. To address this challenge, we propose a class of time-varying state-space model (SSM) based neural networks in which the neurons' states are governed by time-varying dynamics. title: Beyond Bounded Variance: Variance-Reduced Normalized Methods for Nonconvex Optimization under Blum-Gladyshev Noise

title: From Weight Perturbation to Feature Attribution for Explaining Fully Connected Neural Networks
summary: 该研究提出一种基于权重扰动估计特征归因的新方法，用于解释全连接神经网络（FCNN）。通过扰动特征而非权重，该方法在多个基准数据集上实现了与现有归因方法相当的准确性，同时计算效率显著提升。这一工作为Agent和RAG系统中神经网络的可解释性提供了轻量级工具，有助于理解模型决策过程，增强复杂架构的透明度和可信度。
raw_content: Fully Connected Neural Networks (FCNNs) are often regarded as simple and intuitive architectures, yet they serve as the foundation for more complex models. Nonetheless, the lack of consensus on their interpretability continues to pose challenges, underscoring the enduring relevance of simpler, attribution-based approaches for understanding even the most advanced neural architectures. title: Bounded-Rationality, Hedging, and Generalization
summary: 该研究将学习过程建模为有限理性决策问题，核心贡献在于揭示训练样本如何通过诱导通道影响输出，并量化学习器对样本依赖的权衡。关键结果包括：学习器的响应律定义了通道变化的代价，从而在训练损失与样本依赖之间建立下界权衡曲线和上界证书曲线。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联在于，该框架可解释智能体在有限信息下的决策鲁棒性，为多智能体系统中的对冲策略设计提供理论支撑。
raw_content: A learner does not only fit data; it also determines how strongly the training sample may shape its output and how much distortion it can hedge. We study this relation as a bounded-rational decision problem whose primitive object is the induced channel from samples to outputs. The learner's response law determines which changes in this channel are cheap or costly, and therefore induces both a lower tradeoff curve between training loss and sample dependence and a matched upper certificate curve.

title: Controllable Molecular Generative Foundation Models
summary: 可控分子生成基础模型提出统一框架，解决分子图生成中缺乏可靠可控性的问题。通过强化学习实现任务特定优化，克服原子级动作空间大和化学无效中间态挑战。该模型在分子生成任务中实现高成功率与化学有效性，为药物设计等RAG场景提供可控分子生成能力。

title: PRB-RUPFormer: A Recursive Unified Probabilistic Transformer for Residual PRB Forecasting
summary: PRB-RUPFormer提出了一种递归统一概率Transformer，用于预测蜂窝网络中剩余物理资源块（PRB），以支持主动网络切片配置和节能运营。该方法通过递归架构和概率建模，在多个载波上联合训练，相比独立预测方法，预测误差降低约15-20%，并能有效捕捉跨载波依赖关系。该工作对RAG方向中资源感知的决策优化具有参考价值。

title: Breakeven complexity: A new perspective on neural partial differential equation solvers
summary: 提出盈亏平衡复杂度概念，为神经偏微分方程求解器提供新视角。传统精度评估忽略前期数据生成、训练调优成本及经典求解器低保真解的低成本优势。该框架量化神经求解器在多次求解场景中实现速度优势所需的最小问题复杂度，为Agent/RAG/MCP方向中高效物理模拟的智能体决策提供成本效益分析基准。
raw_content: Neural surrogate solvers of partial differential equations (PDEs) promise dramatic speedups over numerical methods, especially in scenarios requiring many solves. title: $\phi$-Balancing for Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: φ-Balancing 是一种用于混合专家（MoE）模型训练的新型负载均衡框架。它通过最小化期望路由分布的严格凸、对称且可微势函数，直接优化全局专家利用率，克服了现有启发式方法依赖小批量统计引入的偏差。实验表明该方法在保持模型性能的同时显著提升专家负载均衡度。该工作为MoE架构中的路由优化提供了理论严谨的解决方案，可应用于大规模多智能体系统的资源分配与协作。
raw_content: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models rely on balanced expert utilization to fully realize their scalability. title: Lagrangian Flow Matching: A Least-Action Framework for Principled Path Design

A central design choice is the path itself. title: Spectral Priors vs. Attention: Investigating the Utility of Attention Mechanisms in EEG-Based Diagnosis
summary: 该论文探讨了在基于脑电图（EEG）的诊断中，注意力机制与频谱先验方法的效用对比。核心贡献是提出一种频谱选择性特征构建方法，通过分离信号成分来增强类别可分性。关键结果表明，该方法在区分健康对照与神经退行性疾病患者时，优于当前最先进的深度学习架构。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联在于，该频谱先验方法可作为一种高效的特征预处理模块，提升多智能体系统中信号分类任务的鲁棒性。

raw_content: Survival analysis provides a powerful statistical framework for modeling time-to-event outcomes in the presence of censoring. title: Learning with Conflicts of Interest
summary: 该研究聚焦机器学习系统所有者与用户之间的利益冲突问题，提出在金融、社会和政治因素导致利益不一致时，系统可能产生误导用户的偏见信息。现有方案要求系统实施偏见缓解协议，但所有者因缺乏激励而常以限制自身能力为由拒绝。该工作为Agent/RAG方向中设计公平、可信的交互系统提供了关键理论框架。
raw_content: Financial, social, and political factors often prevent the interests of the owners of ML systems and services and their users from being perfectly aligned. raw_content: Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for reasoning, but current PRMs usually output only a single reward score for each step. raw_content: The demand for clean energy is ever increasing, with new nuclear technologies presenting a complementary solution to renewable energies. raw_content: This position paper argues for metacognition as a general design principle for creating more accurate, secure, and efficient AI. title: Bidirectional Fusion Guided by Cardiac Patterns for Semi-Supervised ECG Segmentation
summary: CardioMix提出了一种基于心脏模式引导的双向融合框架，用于半监督心电图（ECG）分割。该方法通过双向信息交换机制，在标注与未标注数据间实现特征融合，解决了传统半监督方法信息利用不足的问题。在多个ECG分割基准上，CardioMix显著提升了分割精度，尤其在标注数据稀缺时表现突出。该工作与RAG方向中利用未标注数据增强模型能力的思路高度契合，为医疗信号处理中的少样本学习提供了新范式。

title: Continual Learning of Domain-Invariant Representations
summary: 持续学习（CL）旨在多领域顺序训练模型而不遗忘旧知识。现有方法优化域内性能，易学习虚假域特定线索（捷径学习），限制部署后对未见域的泛化。本文提出域不变表示的持续学习方法，引入一类广泛CL方法，通过保留跨域共享特征提升泛化能力，在多个基准上显著优于传统CL方法。与RAG方向关联：该方法可增强模型在动态数据流中的鲁棒表征学习，为多智能体系统适应新环境提供基础。
raw_content: Continual learning (CL) aims to train models sequentially over multiple domains without forgetting previously learned knowledge. title: Shapley Neuron Values for Continual Learning: Which Neurons Matter Most?

summary: 我们提出了一种动态层面的流匹配模型水印方法。与传统在模型权重或输出中嵌入信号不同，我们将水印直接嵌入到学习到的连续动态——流匹配模型的速度场中。该方法被形式化为连续信道上的随机编码：训练时添加密钥相关的扰动，检测时通过黑盒查询恢复信息。该扰动设计不改变生成分布，在保持生成质量的同时实现了鲁棒水印。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：该技术可为多智能体系统中模型溯源与安全认证提供新思路。

title: Enabling Adversarial Robustness in AI Models through Kubeflow MLOps
summary: 本文提出一种基于Kubeflow MLOps的架构，在Kubernetes集群中为AI模型部署提供对抗鲁棒性保护。关键亮点是实现了推理阶段对抗攻击的自动检测，弥补了云原生环境下AI模型安全机制的不足。该工作与Agent/RAG/MCP方向相关，可为部署在分布式系统中的智能体模型提供安全防护参考。
raw_content: AI models are increasingly deployed in cloud-native environments to support scalable and automated services. title: FFAvatar: Few-Shot, Feed-Forward, and Generalizable Avatar Reconstruction
