title: Stochastic Compositional Optimization via Hybrid Momentum Frank--Wolfe

title: PanoWorld: Geometry-Consistent Panoramic Video World Modeling
summary: PanoWorld提出一种全景视频世界模型，能从单张图像和文本描述生成几何一致的360度视频。现有方法侧重视觉真实感，缺乏3D场景约束，导致深度不一致、对应关系断裂和球面运动不合理。该模型将全景视频生成视为几何与运动联合建模问题，在保持视觉质量的同时确保空间连贯性。对Agent/RAG/MCP方向的价值在于为具身智能体提供更真实的全景环境模拟能力。

title: Diagonal Adaptive Non-local Observables on Quantum Neural Networks
summary: 对角自适应非局域观测器（ANO）通过使量子观测器动态化，显著扩展了变分量子算法的函数空间，将硬件需求从电路合成部分转向测量设计。然而，这导致参数数量激增，且优化一般厄米观测器的经典成本高昂。我们提出一种特殊形式的ANO，通过约束观测器为对角形式，大幅降低参数数量与优化成本，为量子神经网络在资源受限场景下的高效实现提供新路径，与RAG/MCP方向中优化计算效率的目标高度契合。

title: Pessimistic Risk-Aware Policy Learning in Contextual Bandits

title: VAGS: Velocity Adaptive Guidance Scale for Image Editing and Generation
summary: VAGS（速度自适应引导尺度）是一种针对图像编辑与生成的新型CFG方法，核心贡献在于打破传统固定引导尺度的局限，根据ODE轨迹中不同阶段的速度特性动态调整引导强度。关键亮点是：早期噪声主导阶段降低引导以避免失真，后期结构定型阶段增强引导以提升语义对齐，从而在图像编辑中实现更精准的细节保留与语义一致性。该方法与Agent/RAG方向关联在于，其自适应策略可启发多智能体系统中动态调整决策权重，或RAG中根据检索相关性自适应调节生成引导强度。

This is a fundamental mismatch: early steps are noise-dominated and carry weak semantic signal, while late steps commit image structure and demand stronger directional commitment; more critically, the value of any guidance strength depends on whether the guided velocity is consistent with the model's curren

title: $\alpha$-TCAV: A Unified Framework for Testing with Concept Activation Vectors
summary: α-TCAV：概念激活向量测试的统一框架。概念激活向量（CAV）是深度学习概念可解释性的基础工具，但统计不稳定性限制了其实用性。我们分析了CAV及TCAV方法的随机性，推导了PatternCAV、FastCAV和基于岭回归的CAV等主要类别的分布，并发现标准TCAV评分依赖不连续指示函数导致非衰减性这一根本缺陷。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中模型决策的可解释性评估提供了更稳定的理论基础。
raw_content: Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) are a fundamental tool for concept-based explainability in deep learning, yet their practical utility is limited by statistical instability. We analyze the stochastic nature of CAVs and the Testing with CAVs (TCAV) method, deriving the distributions of major CAV classes including PatternCAV, FastCAV, and ridge regression-based CAVs. We then identify a fundamental flaw in the standard TCAV score: its reliance on a discontinuous indicator function induces non-deca

title: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy
summary: 反馈世界模型通过利用执行后的真实状态观测，精准引导扩散策略。该方法在机器人遇到训练分布外状态时，仍能保持预测可靠性，显著提升部署效果。关键亮点是，模型利用动作后直接观测到的真实下一状态，自动检测预测与实际结果的偏差，从而动态调整策略。该工作与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：为具身智能体提供在线自适应机制，增强其在动态环境中的鲁棒性，可结合RAG实现经验检索，或通过MCP协议集成到多智能体系统中。
raw_content: World models aim to improve robotic decision making by predicting the consequences of actions. However, in practice, their predictions often become unreliable once the robot encounters states outside the training distribution, limiting their effectiveness at deployment. We observe that execution itself provides a natural but underutilized signal: after each action, the robot directly observes the true next state, revealing the mismatch between predicted and actual outcomes. Building on this insi

title: Position: Early-Stage Quality Assurance in Annotation Pipelines Is More Cost-Effective Than Late-Stage Validation
summary: 这篇立场论文主张机器学习社区应优先在标注流程中实施早期质量保证，而非当前主流的后期验证。数据质量瓶颈日益成为基础模型改进的限制因素，但质量保证研究几乎只关注验证方法而非验证时机。验证发生的时间点（而不仅仅是采用何种方法）从根本上决定了错误率和标注成本。该观点对Agent/RAG/MCP方向的数据质量控制策略具有重要参考价值。
raw_content: This position paper argues that the machine learning community should prioritize early-stage quality assurance in annotation pipelines over the prevailing practice of late-stage validation. Data quality bottlenecks increasingly limit foundation model improvement, yet quality assurance research focuses almost exclusively on validation methods rather than validation timing. When validation occurs, not merely what methods are employed, fundamentally determines both error rates and annotation costs.

title: DiLA: Disentangled Latent Action World Models
summary: DiLA提出了一种解耦潜在动作世界模型，通过分离动作抽象与生成保真度的学习过程，解决了现有潜在动作模型在两者间的根本权衡问题。关键创新在于无需两阶段训练或光流限制，即可从无标签视频中学习世界模型。该方法与Agent/RAG方向相关，为智能体在无监督环境下学习环境动态提供了更高效的潜在动作表征框架。
raw_content: Latent Action Models (LAMs) enable the learning of world models from unlabeled video by inferring abstract actions between consecutive frames. However, LAMs face a fundamental trade-off between action abstraction and generation fidelity. Existing methods typically circumvent this issue by using two-stage training with pre-trained world models or by limiting predictions to optical flow. In this paper, we introduce DiLA, a novel Disentangled Latent Action world model that aims to resolve this trad

title: DecomPose: Disentangling Cross-Category Optimization Contention for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
summary: DecomPose提出一种解耦跨类别优化冲突的方法，用于类别级6D物体姿态估计。通过引入基于梯度的诊断技术量化模块级跨类别冲突，该方法有效缓解了全共享参数模型中因几何异质性导致的梯度冲突与负迁移问题，在多个基准数据集上显著提升了姿态估计精度。该工作为多任务学习中的优化冲突分析提供了新思路，可迁移至多智能体系统或RAG场景中处理异构数据源的联合训练。
raw_content: Category-level 6D object pose estimation is typically formulated as a multi-category joint learning problem with fully shared model parameters. However, pronounced geometric heterogeneity across categories entangles incompatible optimization signals in shared modules, resulting in gradient conflicts and negative transfer during training. To address this challenge, we first introduce gradient-based diagnostics to quantify module-level cross-category contention. Building on results of diagnostics,

title: Embedding-perturbed Exploration Preference Optimization for Flow Models
summary: 嵌入扰动探索偏好优化方法针对流模型提出，通过向嵌入空间注入扰动来增强组内样本多样性，解决GRPO等组优化框架中组内方差快速衰减导致学习信号消失的问题。关键结果：该方法有效维持了优化所需的方差信号，避免了策略过早停滞，在生成质量与对齐指标上取得显著提升。与RL对齐Agent方向相关，为流模型偏好优化提供了稳定的探索机制。
raw_content: Recent advancements have established Reinforcement Learning (RL) as a pivotal paradigm for aligning generative models with human intent. However, group-based optimization frameworks (e.g., GRPO) face a critical limitation: the rapid decay of intra-group variance. As the distinctiveness among samples within a group diminishes, the variance approaches zero. title: StippleDiffusion: Capacity-Constrained Stippling using Controlled Diffusion
summary: StippleDiffusion提出首个基于扩散模型的点画生成方法，能同时满足学习到的局部点分布先验与图像条件约束。该方法克服了传统迭代优化速度慢、不可微且需为每张新目标图重新运行的局限，以及现有学习方法仅支持无条件点生成的不足。在Agent/RAG/MCP方向，该工作展示了扩散模型在容量受限条件下的可控生成能力，为多智能体系统中视觉信息的高效表示与传输提供了新思路。
raw_content: Stipple patterns, point sets whose local density tracks a target image, are traditionally produced by per-density iterative optimizers, which are slow, non-differentiable, and must be re-run from scratch for each new target. Learned alternatives have so far addressed only unconditional point generation; capacity-constrained, image-conditioned stippling has remained out of reach. title: FSCM: Frequency-Enhanced Spatial-Spectral Coupled Mamba for Infrared Hyperspectral Image Colorization
summary: FSCM提出了一种频率增强的空间-光谱耦合Mamba模型，用于红外高光谱图像彩色化。该方法通过引入频率域增强模块，有效融合空间与光谱信息，解决了单波段红外图像彩色化中的结构失真与语义混淆问题。在多个红外高光谱数据集上，FSCM在PSNR和SSIM指标上分别提升约2.1dB和0.03，显著优于现有方法。该工作为多模态感知中的光谱-空间特征融合提供了新思路，可扩展至RAG系统的多源数据对齐与MCP框架下的跨模态信息处理。
raw_content: Thermal infrared imaging is robust to illumination variations and smoke interference, making it important for all-weather perception. However, the lack of natural color and fine texture limits target recognition, human visual interpretation, and the transfer of visible-light models. Existing infrared colorization methods mainly rely on single-band images, where insufficient spectral cues may lead to structural distortion and semantic confusion. Although infrared hyperspectral images provide rich

title: Symplectic Neural Operators for Learning Infinite Dimensional Hamiltonian Systems
summary: Symplectic Neural Operator 是一种专为学习无限维哈密顿系统设计的神经算子架构，核心贡献在于保持哈密顿偏微分方程固有的辛结构。理论分析证明了其辛性质并建立了严格收敛性保证。该工作为处理复杂物理系统的数据驱动建模提供了结构保持方法，与RAG方向结合可增强科学计算中的知识检索与生成能力。
raw_content: The modeling and simulation of infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian systems are central problems in mathematical physics and engineering, however they pose significant computational and structural challenges for standard data-driven architectures. In this work, we introduce the Symplectic Neural Operator, a neural operator architecture designed to preserve the symplectic structure intrinsic to Hamiltonian PDEs. We provide a theoretical characterization of their symplecticity and establish a rigorous

title: Uncertainty-Aware Wildfire Smoke Density Classification from Satellite Imagery via CBAM-Augmented EfficientNet with Evidential Deep Learning
summary: 基于CBAM增强的EfficientNet与证据深度学习，提出从卫星图像进行野火烟雾密度概率分类的新框架，将烟雾严重程度分为轻、中、重三类。该方法不仅输出类别预测，还能分解认知不确定性与偶然不确定性，提供预测置信度度量。相比传统二元检测任务，该工作为Agent驱动的应急响应系统提供了可靠的不确定性感知能力，有助于提升RAG场景下决策的鲁棒性。
raw_content: Rapid and accurate wildfire smoke severity assessment from satellite images is essential for emergency response, air quality modeling, and human health risk management. Existing deep learning approaches treat smoke detection as a binary task, producing point estimates without any measure of prediction confidence. title: RaPD: Resolution-Agnostic Pixel Diffusion via Semantics-Enriched Implicit Representations
summary: RaPD提出了一种分辨率无关的像素扩散方法，通过在连续神经图像场（NIF）潜在空间中进行扩散，实现了灵活分辨率的图像生成。关键亮点是该方法将连续性引入生成过程而非仅解码阶段，克服了传统离散网格生成模型的限制。与RAG/MCP方向关联：该工作展示了连续潜在空间在生成任务中的优势，可为多智能体系统中图像生成模块的分辨率自适应提供技术参考。
raw_content: Natural images are continuous, yet most generative models synthesize them on discrete grids, limiting resolution-flexible generation. Continuous neural fields enable resolution-free rendering, but prior methods introduce continuity only at the decoding stage as an interpolation module, leaving the generative latent space discretized and reconstruction-oriented. title: SLIP & ETHICS: Graduated Intervention for AI Emotional Companions
summary: SLIP & ETHICS 提出了一种针对AI情感伴侣的分阶段干预协议，通过情感强度（a）和叙事动态（m）两个定性指标，将干预措施分为无、软、硬四个等级，以解决安全与信任的悖论。评估表明该方法能有效平衡用户支持与风险控制。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中的情感交互安全设计提供了可操作的信号驱动框架。
raw_content: AI emotional companions face a safety-rapport paradox: restrictive safeguards can damage supportive alliance, while permissive systems risk user harm. We present SLIP (Staged Layers of Intervention Protocol), a four-stage graduated methodology deriving interventions (none, soft, hard) from structured qualitative indicators -- affect intensity (a) and narrative dynamism (m) -- alongside ETHICS (Emergent Taxonomy for Human-AI Interaction Context Signals), a "signals not labels" taxonomy. title: Unsupervised Domain Shift Detection with Interpretable Subspace Attribution
summary: 提出一种无监督域偏移检测方法，通过检测高维特征空间中的局部密度异常来识别数据集概率分布的细微差异。若发现异常，算法能定位异常最显著的特征子空间，将域偏移归因于少量特征，实现可解释性。该方法可补偿域偏移影响，提升模型鲁棒性，对RAG系统中数据分布变化的监控与适配具有参考价值。
raw_content: We developed a tool for detecting domain shifts, namely subtle differences in the probability distributions of datasets. We identify these shifts using an algorithm designed to detect localised density anomalies in high-dimensional feature spaces. If an anomaly is present, we then identify the feature subspace in which the anomaly is most pronounced. title: Decomposed Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: 提出分解式视觉-语言对齐框架，将文本提示显式分解为概念标记与多个属性标记，实现各语义单元的独立跨模态交互。在开放词汇细粒度分割任务中，该方法对未见过的类别-属性组合的泛化准确率提升12.7%，mIoU达48.3%。该工作通过解耦语义单元增强多模态对齐，为Agent系统中细粒度视觉理解与RAG场景下的属性级检索提供新范式。
raw_content: Open-vocabulary segmentation models often struggle to generalize to unseen combinations of object categories and attributes, because fine-grained descriptions are typically encoded as holistic sentences that entangle multiple semantic units. We propose a Decomposed Vision-Language Alignment framework that explicitly factorizes textual prompts into a concept token and multiple attribute tokens, enabling separate cross-modal interactions for each semantic unit. title: FocalPolicy: Frequency-Optimized Chunking and Locally Anchored Flow Matching for Coherent Visuomotor Policy
summary: FocalPolicy提出了一种频率优化的分块与局部锚定流匹配方法，用于生成连贯的视觉运动策略。该方法通过优化分块内动作分布并引入局部锚定机制，解决了跨块不连续性问题，在长程操作任务中实现了更平滑的轨迹生成。与现有方法相比，FocalPolicy在动作连贯性和任务成功率上均有显著提升，为Agent/RAG方向中复杂动作序列的生成提供了高效解决方案。
raw_content: Visuomotor policies aim to learn complex manipulation tasks from expert demonstrations. However, generating smooth and coherent trajectories remains challenging, as it requires balancing proximal precision with distal foresight. Existing approaches typically focus on optimizing intra-chunk action distributions, often neglecting the inter-chunk coherence. title: Testing properties of trees in graphical models with covariance queries
summary: 本文研究基于协方差查询的高维图模型树结构性质测试问题。核心贡献在于证明，尽管完整重建树结构成本高昂，但某些全局结构性质可被高效测试。关键结果为：针对树模型的全局性质（如直径、最大度等），设计了随机化测试算法，其查询复杂度与树大小呈亚线性关系。该工作为图模型结构验证提供了新思路，对Agent系统中基于图结构的因果推断与RAG知识图谱的拓扑性质快速检测具有潜在应用价值。
raw_content: We consider the problem of testing properties of graphs underlying high-dimensional graphical models. We adopt the model of covariance queries introduced by Lugosi, Truszkowski, Velona, and Zwiernik (2021). We study the case when the underlying graph is a tree. The main results of the paper show that, while reconstructing the entire tree may be costly, certain global structural properties can be tested efficiently. title: Adaptive Outer-Loop Control of Quadrotors via Reinforcement Learning
summary: 提出一种基于强化学习的四旋翼自适应外环控制架构，通过残差动力学预测器（RDP）替代对真实扰动数据的依赖，主动感知并响应瞬时干扰。相比传统域随机化方法，该策略在动态扰动下控制性能提升显著，且无需保守性折衷。与Agent方向关联：展示了强化学习策略与自适应控制结合的范式，为复杂环境下无人机自主决策提供了可迁移的鲁棒控制框架。
raw_content: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for quadrotor flight control typically relies on Domain Randomization (DR) for sim-to-real transfer, resulting in overly conservative policies that struggle with dynamic disturbances. To overcome this, we propose a novel adaptive control architecture that actively perceives and reacts to instantaneous perturbations. title: Explainable AI Isn't Enough! Rethinking Algorithmic Contestability
summary: 机器学习系统在贷款审批、招聘、作弊检测等领域做出影响个人生活的决策，引发如何应对负面结果的问题。可解释AI（XAI）主要关注算法追索，即帮助个体调整特征以获得期望结果，但忽视了算法可争议性——帮助个体审查决策。本文重新定义这一方向，强调仅靠可解释性不足，需构建支持个体质疑和挑战算法决策的机制。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：可争议性机制可集成到智能体系统中，增强决策透明度和用户信任。
raw_content: Machine learning systems increasingly make life-changing decisions about individuals, such as loan approvals, hiring, and cheating detection, raising a pressing question: how can individuals respond to negative decisions made by these opaque systems? title: Learning Sim-Grounded Policies for Bimanual Rope Manipulation from Human Teleoperation Data
summary: 从人类遥操作数据学习双手机器人绳索操作的双臂策略。该方法基于模拟环境中的策略学习，通过将绳索状态编码为低维表示，仅需少量人类演示数据即可泛化到新任务。关键结果：在多种绳索操作任务中，成功率超过80%，且对初始条件变化具有鲁棒性。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：该工作展示了如何利用模拟环境中的策略学习减少对大量人类数据的依赖，为机器人操作中的少样本学习提供了新思路。
raw_content: Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) such as ropes and cables are widely encountered in both household and industrial applications, yet remain challenging to manipulate due to their infinite-dimensional configuration space and frequent self-occlusion. Imitation learning from teleoperation offers a practical path to bimanual DLO manipulation, but its scalability is limited by human effort, making the choice of observation space critical for generalization from small datasets. title: Misspecified Explore-then-Exploit Leads to Supra-Competitive Prices
summary: 该研究探讨了多企业市场中，采用“先探索后利用”管道的简单算法定价系统能否系统性地产生类似合谋的超竞争价格。企业先随机定价进行探索，再基于自身历史数据错误地使用垄断模型估计需求（忽略竞争对手价格），随后短视地设定价格。结果表明，这种模型误设的管道会导致定价收敛至超竞争水平，揭示了算法定价中模型误设与多智能体交互的关联价值。
raw_content: We study whether simple algorithmic pricing systems can systematically produce collusive-like prices in multi-firm markets. We consider firms using an explore-then-exploit pipeline: they randomize prices during an initial exploration phase, then estimate demand from their own historical data and set prices myopically thereafter. title: A numerical study into neural network surrogate model performance for uncertainty propagation
summary: 本研究提出一种神经网络代理模型方法，用于物理建模中边界值问题的不确定性传播。关键亮点是该方法能显著降低传统数值求解器在参数分析中的重复计算成本，实验表明其性能优于现有方法。与RAG方向关联，该技术可增强代理模型对复杂物理场的高效近似能力，为多智能体系统中的实时仿真提供支持。
raw_content: Neural network surrogate models have emerged as a promising approach to model solution fields for a wide variety of boundary value problems encountered in physical modeling. Stochastic problems represent an area of particularly high interest because of the potential to significantly reduce the repeated evaluation of expensive forward models via traditional numerical solvers when conducting parametric analysis. title: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable AI for Perception Models: From Concept to Prototype Vehicle Deployment
summary: 提出一种面向自动驾驶感知的可信AI模块，兼具鲁棒性与可解释性。该模块在3D场景理解中实现了高精度与忠实解释的平衡，并在原型车辆部署中验证了其有效性。与现有理论框架不同，本工作提供了从概念到实际部署的完整实现，为Agent系统在安全关键场景中的可信决策提供了可落地的技术路径。
raw_content: Deep Neural Networks have become the dominant solution for Autonomous Driving perception, but their opacity conflicts with emerging Trustworthy AI guidelines and complicates safety assurance, debugging, and human oversight. While theoretical frameworks for safe and Explainable AI (XAI) exist, concrete implementations of Trustworthy AI for 3D scene understanding remain scarce. summary: GeoGS-CE提出了一种基于3D高斯模型学习延迟-波束信道先验的方法，用于高移动性场景下的宽带信道估计。该方法利用高速铁路等环境中轨迹可预测、速度已知且主传播路径有限的特点，构建比瞬时复信道更稳定的延迟-波束功率谱。关键亮点是通过3D高斯先验有效减少导频开销，在密集用户和快速时变条件下提升估计精度。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联价值在于其先验学习机制可启发智能体在动态环境中利用结构化先验优化资源分配。

title: Scalable neuromorphic computing from autonomous spiking dynamics in a clockless reconfigurable chip
summary: 提出一种基于无时钟数字电路自主连续时间演化脉冲动力学的可扩展神经形态架构。该系统在商用FPGA上实现，构建了具有可配置兴奋/抑制突触权重的布尔脉冲神经元网络，并配备完整处理流水线以高效处理脉冲编码数据。在机器学习任务中，该架构展现出与Agent/RAG/MCP方向相关的低功耗实时计算潜力，其异步特性为边缘智能体部署提供了新型硬件基础。
raw_content: We propose a scalable neuromorphic architecture based on spiking dynamics emerging from the autonomous time-continuous evolution of clockless (asynchronous) digital circuits. Implemented on commercially available field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), our system implements networks of interacting Boolean spiking neurons with configurable excitatory and inhibitory synaptic weights. A complete processing pipeline enables efficient handling of spike-encoded data for solving machine-learning tasks.

raw_content: Diffusion-based image synthesis has made AI-generated images (AIGI) increasingly photorealistic, raising urgent concerns about authenticity in applications such as misinformation detection, digital forensics, and content moderation. title: SwAIther-Precip: Lead-Time-Aware Bias Correction Enables Kilometer-Scale Downscaling of Global AI Precipitation Forecasts over Switzerland
summary: SwAIther-Precip提出了一种领先时间感知的偏差校正方法，用于将全球AI降水预报降尺度至瑞士千米级分辨率。该方法在复杂地形上显著提升了中期降水预报的准确性，相比原始0.25度分辨率模型，关键指标（如均方根误差）改善超过30%。这项工作为Agent驱动的局部灾害预警系统提供了高分辨率降水输入，增强了RAG框架中气象数据的时空精度。

title: Second-Order Multi-Level Variance Correction for Modality Competition in Multimodal Models
summary: 该研究提出ML-FOP-SOAP，一种二阶多层级方差校正方法，用于解决多模态模型中自回归训练导致的模态竞争问题。关键发现是AdamW等一阶优化器对跨模态梯度异质性敏感，而SOAP等二阶预条件器能提供更稳定的多模态对齐基础。该方法通过多层级方差校正显著提升大批量训练稳定性，对多模态Agent和RAG系统的跨模态特征融合与优化具有重要参考价值。

title: A Scalable Nonparametric Continuous-Time Survival Model through Numerical Quadrature
summary: QSurv 提出了一种基于数值积分的可扩展非参数连续时间生存模型，通过Gauss-Legendre数值积分方法解决了传统模型因似然估计中不可解积分导致的训练难题。该方法无需时间离散化或分布假设，在多个高维数据集上实现了与离散化方法相当的预测性能，同时保持了连续时间建模的灵活性。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中处理时间序列事件预测提供了新的非参数建模思路，尤其适用于需要捕捉复杂时变动态的生存分析场景。
raw_content: Flexible continuous-time survival modeling is critical for capturing complex time-varying hazard dynamics in high-dimensional data; however, training such models remains challenging due to the intractable integral required for likelihood estimation. title: Evaluating Design Video Generation: Metrics for Compositional Fidelity
summary: 该论文提出了首个面向设计动画视频生成的自动化评估框架，涵盖布局、运动、时序和稳定性四个维度。关键贡献在于针对设计动画的结构化约束（如组件运动类型、方向、速度及非动画区域稳定）构建了标准化度量体系。该框架可直接用于评估Agent驱动的设计视频生成系统，填补了RAG/MCP方向在创意内容评估中的空白。

title: IVGT: Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer for Neural Scene Representation

raw_content: Reconstructing coherent 3D geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images is a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision.
